That is an important practical point: the improvement is not only from adding teacher hints, but also from stabilizing the RL dynamics of small students.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact numbers. What is clear is the comparison set: distillation, on-policy or self-distillation style baselines, and pure RL baselines; and the evaluation axes: generalization, hard-question learning, and component ablations. When reading the paper, the main tables and the 0.8B-student results deserve the closest attention, since that is where the paper’s claim is strongest.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it around the failure modes, not around the method name. Start with the introduction and the overview figures. The paper is easiest to understand once two rejected options are clear: logit imitation is problematic for small students, and directly using teacher responses inside the policy gradient creates off-policy drift.

Then go to the formal definitions of BCQ, NCQ, and the prompt replay buffer. The most important implementation question is what exactly receives gradient and what remains context only. That is where the paper’s main claim lives. Many methods in this area sound like RL but quietly rely on offline supervision; this paper is trying hard not to do that.

Next, read the ablations carefully. Prioritize the effect of removing BCQ, NCQ, and replay; the sensitivity to the hard-question threshold at 0.5; the role of replay capacity and eviction; and whether zero-advantage groups are included in normalization statistics. In small-model training, these details often matter more than the algorithm label.

Finally, focus on the generalization results rather than only in-distribution metrics. The paper’s main argument is not just higher reward, but less brittleness than distillation beyond the training corpus. If there is an error analysis section, it is worth checking whether the student is truly reasoning better or merely learning to choose among candidates.

If time is limited, a good path is: introduction, method figure, main result table, and key ablation table. That should take about 30 to 45 minutes. If you want to assess transferability to your own training stack, then read the implementation appendix and hyperparameter details.

recommendation.zh: 读 prompt 构造和失败样例；“teacher in prompt, not gradients”是干净的训练信号边界。
recommendation.en: Read the prompt construction and failure cases; “teacher in prompts, not gradients” is a clean boundary for teacher-assisted RL signals.

paper.title: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack
paper.abstract: In this report, we present Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA, abbreviated as HyVLA-0.5, an end-to-end system that spans the full robot learning stack: data collection, model design, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. Each component serves a distinct role in this stack.

summary.core_problem: 把 VLA 模型从单个策略网络扩展成可在真实机器人上部署的完整学习栈，覆盖数据、模型、继续预训练、SFT、RL 后训练和部署。
summary.importance: 贡献是系统技术报告，而不是单点算法。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察 embodied VLA 如何组织 continue pretraining、监督微调和 RL post-training 的接口。
summary.technical_approach: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA 描述端到端 robot learning stack。摘要明确包括数据采集、模型设计、continued pre-training、supervised fine-tuning、RL post-training 和真实世界部署；各组件在栈中承担不同角色。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未披露模型参数量、数据规模、机器人任务集、baseline 或量化结果。只能确认其定位为真实机器人系统报告，强调从训练到部署的全链路而非单一 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The report aims to turn VLA models into a deployable real-world robot learning stack spanning data, model design, continued pretraining, SFT, RL post-training, and deployment.
summary_en.importance: This is a system report rather than a single algorithmic contribution. For pretraining researchers, the relevant part is how an embodied VLA stack connects continued pretraining, supervised tuning, and RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA is presented as an end-to-end robot learning stack. The abstract lists data collection, model design, continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment as coordinated components.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model size, data scale, robot task suite, baselines, or quantitative gains. It frames the work as a full-stack real-world deployment report.

recommendation.zh: 若做 embodied pretrain，可扫训练栈接口；摘要看不出新的建模范式，别按基础模型技术报告读。
recommendation.en: Skim the training-stack interfaces if you work on embodied pretraining; the abstract does not indicate a new modeling paradigm.

paper.title: Diffusion Policy Optimization without Drifting Apart
paper.abstract: RL post-training has become increasingly pivotal for improving diffusion policies, but existing diffusion policy-gradient methods are often unstable and cannot achieve reliable policy improvement. We identify the cause as the double-drift phenomenon: optimizing a variational surrogate can let the ELBO separate from the true log-likelihood, which then makes the resulting proxy policy gradient misaligned with the true policy gradient of expected return. We propose \textbf{DiPOD}, a diffusion polic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 diffusion policy 做 RL post-training 时的梯度可靠性问题。diffusion 模型的真实 log-likelihood 通常不可 tractable，现有方法用 ELBO、EUBO、mean-field、一阶估计等 proxy 代替；但 RL 更新会让这些 variational proxy 与真实 likelihood 的差距变大，进一步导致 proxy policy gradient 偏离真实 policy gradient。论文把这个耦合失效称为 double drift。
summary.importance: 它对 diffusion LLM 的 post-train 有直接启发。AR 模型做 RL 时可以直接用 token logprob；dLLM 若用 variational surrogate 做策略梯度，不能只看 reward 是否上升，还要维护生成模型自身的概率结构。论文提出的关键信号是：pretraining 形成的 tight-bound 区域在 RL 中会被破坏，需要把“保持 likelihood proxy 可信”作为训练约束。这个问题也连接 pretrain-posttrain 接口：预训练目标越接近后续 RL 所用的 surrogate，post-training 越稳定；但 RL 过程中仍需要持续校准 surrogate。
summary.technical_approach: DiPOD 的原则是把 policy improvement 和 tight-bound maintenance 交替进行。理论部分先定义一类 adequate proxy gradient：如果 evidence bound 与真实 likelihood 足够贴合，那么基于 proxy 的策略梯度方向与真实策略梯度一致。问题在于普通 RL 更新不会保持这种贴合。DiPOD 用 policy-preserving self-distillation 把模型拉回 tight-bound regime，再执行 policy-improving gradient update。实际算法做了一个简单近似：每次 diffusion policy-gradient update 都在同一批 on-policy rollout 上加入 ELBO maximization regularizer。这个 ELBO 项不是普通的预训练损失复用，而是为了在当前策略分布附近降低 variational discrepancy，使 proxy gradient 不至于随着训练偏离真实目标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖离散 diffusion language model post-training 和连续控制 flow policy。离散任务包括 GSM8K、MATH500、Sudoku、Countdown；连续控制包括 humanoid motion tracking。给出的结论是，加入 on-policy ELBO regularizer 后，训练稳定性和 reward optimization 都有明显改善。当前材料没有提供具体准确率、reward 数值或 ablation 表格，因此不应过度解读幅度。需要重点查看完整实验中的三类证据：ELBO-log-likelihood gap 或 proxy tightness 的变化、reward 曲线稳定性、ELBO regularizer 权重和 on-policy/off-policy 数据选择的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35 分钟。先看 double drift 的定义和推导，确认 ELBO drift 如何传导到 policy-gradient drift；再看 DiPOD 的 interleaving 形式和 practical algorithm，重点是为什么 self-distillation 被称为 policy-preserving，以及为什么实现上可以退化为 on-policy ELBO regularization；最后看 dLLM reasoning 任务和 continuous-control 任务的实验曲线。对做 dLLM RL 的读者，最值得深挖的是 surrogate tightness 的监控指标和 regularizer 系数如何随训练阶段调整。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why reinforcement-learning post-training is unstable for diffusion policies. Diffusion models usually do not provide a tractable exact log-likelihood, so existing RL methods optimize policy-gradient proxies based on ELBO, EUBO, mean-field estimates, one-step estimates, or imposed dependency structures. The paper identifies a coupled failure mode: RL updates loosen the variational bound, and once the bound drifts away from the true log-likelihood, the proxy policy gradient also drifts away from the true policy-gradient direction.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to diffusion LLM post-training. Autoregressive LMs expose token log probabilities, but diffusion LMs often rely on variational surrogates. Reward improvement alone is not enough if the surrogate no longer represents the executed diffusion policy. The useful lesson is that post-training must preserve the probabilistic structure inherited from pretraining. It also clarifies a pretrain-to-posttrain interface issue: objectives that are tight near initialization can become unreliable under RL unless tightness is actively maintained.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiPOD enforces two requirements: improve the downstream return and keep the likelihood proxy tight. The analysis defines adequate proxy gradients, where the proxy gradient matches the true likelihood gradient when the evidence bound is tight. Since standard RL updates do not preserve this condition, DiPOD alternates policy-preserving self-distillation with policy-improving gradient updates. The practical version is simple: add an on-policy ELBO maximization term to each diffusion policy-gradient update on the same rollout batch. This regularizer reduces variational discrepancy around the current policy distribution, improving alignment between the proxy gradient and the intended policy gradient.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover discrete diffusion-LM post-training tasks, including GSM8K, MATH500, Sudoku, and Countdown, as well as continuous-control flow policies such as humanoid motion tracking. The reported outcome is improved training stability and better reward optimization after adding the on-policy ELBO regularizer. The provided material does not include exact accuracy or reward numbers. The key evidence to inspect in the full results is the evolution of proxy tightness, reward curves, and ablations on the ELBO regularization strength and rollout distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective deep reading in about 35 minutes. Read the double-drift analysis first, especially the link between ELBO-log-likelihood discrepancy and policy-gradient misalignment. Then read the DiPOD algorithm and check how the ideal interleaving is approximated by an on-policy ELBO regularizer. The most useful experimental sections are the dLLM reasoning tasks, the continuous-control transfer of the same principle, and the ablations on regularization. For diffusion-LM RL, the main implementation question is how to monitor surrogate tightness during training.

recommendation.zh: 非 AR LM 接 RL 的关键坑在目标漂移；先看 double-drift 诊断和 ELBO 正则消融。
recommendation.en: For RL on non-AR LMs, the useful part is the objective-drift diagnosis; read the double-drift analysis and ELBO-regularizer ablations first.

paper.title: Select and Improve: Understanding the Mechanics of Post-Training for Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has rapidly emerged as a key component in the training of reasoning and coding models, yet it remains poorly understood from a mechanistic perspective. We study how and through what underlying processes capabilities are acquired or enhanced via reinforcement learning post-training. Our analysis, based on controlled math reasoning experiments with Qwen-2.5-1.5B, reveals two core mechanisms: strategy selection and strategy improvement. Our results highlight the role of SFT d

summary.core_problem: 揭示强化学习后训练提升大模型推理能力的底层机制，明确SFT与RL数据在能力提升中的具体功能分工。
summary.importance: 机制分析类核心贡献，首次拆解出RL后训练提升推理的两个独立子机制（策略选择、策略改进），为预训练数据设计、后训练数据配置提供可操作的量化指导。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Qwen-2.5-1.5B开展受控数学推理实验，通过控制SFT数据的推理策略多样性、RL训练数据的难度梯度两个变量，分别观测两个机制的激活条件与性能贡献。
summary.experiments: 使用Qwen-2.5-1.5B作为基座模型，在数学推理任务集上开展多组受控ablation；验证了SFT多样策略数据可激活策略选择能力，RL难度递增数据可实现策略改进，二者结合可最大化推理性能。
summary.authors_note: Akshay Krishnamurthy 为微软研究院资深研究员，长期从事机器学习理论与大模型训练机制研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Uncover the underlying mechanisms by which reinforcement learning post-training improves LLM reasoning capabilities, and clarify the specific functional division of SFT and RL data in capability enhancement.
summary_en.importance: Core mechanism analysis contribution, first decomposing two independent sub-mechanisms (strategy selection, strategy improvement) for RL post-training to boost reasoning, providing actionable quantitative guidance for pretraining data design and post-training data configuration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conducts controlled math reasoning experiments on Qwen-2.5-1.5B, controlling two variables (reasoning strategy diversity of SFT data, difficulty gradient of RL data) to observe activation conditions and performance contributions of the two mechanisms respectively.
summary_en.experiments: Uses Qwen-2.5-1.5B as the base model, conducts multiple controlled ablations on math reasoning task sets; verifies that SFT data with diverse strategies activates strategy selection, RL data with increasing difficulty achieves strategy improvement, and their combination maximizes reasoning performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Akshay Krishnamurthy is a senior researcher at Microsoft Research, with long-term work on machine learning theory and LLM training mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练的双机制拆解直接修正对SFT/RL数据分工的认知，应立刻在内部后训练ablation中验证。
recommendation.en: The dual-mechanism decomposition of RL post-training directly revises understanding of SFT/RL data division; should be immediately validated in internal post-training ablations.

paper.title: Cross-Epoch Adaptive Rollout Optimization for RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: LLM post-training often relies on reinforcement learning methods that sample multiple rollouts per prompt, yet most existing approaches use a fixed rollout budget for every prompt, despite large differences in the training signal different prompts provide. In this paper, we study adaptive rollout allocation under a fixed global budget and formulate the problem as online resource allocation with prompt-level diminishing returns. Our method, CERO, maintains a Beta posterior over each prompt's succ

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 的强化学习后训练（如 GRPO）中，固定为每个 prompt 分配相同数量的 rollout 会导致严重的计算资源浪费，因为不同 prompt 的难度和学习价值差异巨大。
summary.importance: 提出了一种跨 epoch 的全局 rollout 预算分配机制，将 RL 后训练的数据收集过程建模为带预算的在线优化问题，为提升 RL 训练的数据效率提供了新的理论框架和实用算法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CERO 框架。它维护每个 prompt 成功率的 Beta 后验分布，并用后验期望的伯努利奖励方差来估计额外 rollout 的边际价值。这种价值估计构建了一个随累积分配量饱和的凹效用函数，体现了边际收益递减。通过 Fenchel 对偶，CERO 将跨 epoch 的全局预算约束转化为一个全局动态预算价格（乘子），并在每个 epoch 比较 prompt 的边际价值与当前价格来决定是否分配 rollout。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理任务上，CERO 在多个开源 LLM 上均优于标准的 GRPO，证明了在固定总 rollout 预算下，跨 epoch 动态分配能带来更好的策略优化效果。理论上，该算法在固定效用假设下达到了 $O(\sqrt{K})$ 的遗憾界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Problem Formulation 和方法推导部分，理解其如何将 rollout 分配转化为在线优化问题，以及 Beta 后验如何与边际价值估计结合。这对于设计更高效的 RLHF/RLAIF 数据收集策略很有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL post-training for LLMs (e.g., GRPO), assigning a fixed number of rollouts to each prompt wastes compute, as prompts vary significantly in difficulty and learning value.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a cross-epoch global rollout budget allocation mechanism, framing RL data collection as a budgeted online optimization problem. It provides a novel theoretical framework and a practical algorithm for improving RL training data efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the CERO framework. It maintains a Beta posterior over each prompt's success probability and uses the posterior expected Bernoulli reward variance to estimate the marginal value of additional rollouts. This induces a concave, saturating utility function reflecting diminishing returns. Using Fenchel duality, CERO translates the global cross-epoch budget constraint into a dynamic global budget price (multiplier). In each epoch, it allocates rollouts by comparing a prompt's marginal value against this global price.
summary_en.experiments: On mathematical reasoning tasks, CERO outperforms standard GRPO across multiple open-weight LLMs, demonstrating that dynamic cross-epoch allocation yields better policy optimization under a fixed total rollout budget. Theoretically, it achieves an $O(\sqrt{K})$ regret bound under fixed utility assumptions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Problem Formulation and the methodological derivation to understand how rollout allocation is cast as an online optimization problem, and how the Beta posterior is linked to marginal value estimation. This is highly relevant for designing efficient RLHF/RLAIF data collection strategies.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改RL目标，只改算力花法；若你在做RLVR/RLHF训练系统，先看它的预算耦合建模，方法可能比结果更值得抄到内部pipeline里。
recommendation.en: It does not change the RL objective, only where rollout compute goes; worth reading if you run RLHF/RLVR systems and care about budget allocation more than headline gains.

paper.title: Beyond Output Matching: Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillatio
paper.abstract: Demand for low-precision inference, including NVFP4-based approaches, has grown as large language models are increasingly deployed in latency and cost constrained production environments. Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) helps recover accuracy lost under low bit quantization by training a quantized student to match the output distribution of a frozen higher precision teacher via a KL-divergence loss. In this work, we first provide a representation level diagnosis of QAD: output matching alo

summary.core_problem: 量化感知蒸馏（QAD）仅通过KL散度对齐输出分布，无法保证中间激活层的内部几何结构被保留。论文发现仅用KL的QAD反而会加剧表示漂移——尤其是经过RL后训练的模型——尽管输出分布与老师模型已经对齐。
summary.importance: 对低比特LLM量化蒸馏的研究提供了诊断层面的新视角：输出对齐 ≠ 内部表示保真。这一发现也间接提醒预训练研究者，蒸馏/对齐等后训练过程中，内部表示几何可能被悄悄破坏而指标不反映。
summary.technical_approach: 在标准QAD目标（KL散度对齐输出分布）之外，增加了一层Centered Kernel Alignment（CKA）正则项，对中间激活的几何结构做显式约束。CKA的核心优势是对正交变换和各向同性缩放不变，比逐点MSE更鲁棒于量化带来的尺度偏移和截断。总损失为KL项加层间CKA对齐项。实现采用teacher-top-k变体减少词表级蒸馏的通信开销，k=8192。
summary.experiments: 在Nemotron 3 Nano（混合Mamba-Transformer MoE）和Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上评测。KL-only QAD会降低各层与BF16老师的CKA相似度，RL后训练模型的漂移最严重。CKA-QAD将内部对齐恢复到接近BF16水平，额外开销仅为step时间的0.5%和峰值VRAM的7.0%（在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上）。下游任务上，AIME25从68.5%→72.3%，GPQA-D从59.5%→61.1%，LiveCodeBench-v5从57.9%→59.8%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Section 3（CKA-QAD目标函数和实现细节）和Section 4中的CKA相似度热力图（展示各层漂移模式）。对于预训练研究者，最有价值的是其诊断部分：如何用CKA系统地揭示输出对齐掩盖内部退化这一现象。预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的文本中明确给出，作者是做NVFP4量化和QAD方向的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD) using only KL divergence to align output distributions does not guarantee preservation of the internal geometric structure of intermediate activations. The paper finds that KL-only QAD can actually exacerbate representational drift — especially in RL-post-trained models — even when output distributions are well-aligned to the teacher.
summary_en.importance: Provides a diagnostic insight for low-bit LLM quantization distillation: output alignment does not equal internal representation fidelity. This finding also indirectly alerts pretraining researchers that internal geometry may be silently corrupted during distillation/alignment without being reflected in output metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: In addition to the standard QAD objective (KL divergence for output distribution alignment), a layerwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) regularization term is added to explicitly constrain the geometry of intermediate activations. CKA is invariant to orthogonal transformations and isotropic scaling, making it more robust than pointwise MSE against quantization-induced scale shifts and clipping. Total loss combines KL term and inter-layer CKA alignment. Implementation uses a teacher-top-k variant with k=8192 to reduce communication cost of vocabulary-level distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Nemotron 3 Nano (hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE) and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507. KL-only QAD reduces CKA similarity to the BF16 teacher across layers, with RL-post-trained models showing the most severe drift. CKA-QAD restores internal alignment to near-BF16 levels with only 0.5% step-time overhead and 7.0% peak VRAM overhead. On downstream tasks: AIME25 68.5%→72.3%, GPQA-D 59.5%→61.1%, LiveCodeBench-v5 57.9%→59.8%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (CKA-QAD objective and implementation details) and Section 4's CKA similarity heatmaps showing per-layer drift patterns. The most valuable part for pretraining researchers is the diagnostic framing: how CKA systematically reveals that output alignment can mask internal degradation. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided text; authors work on NVFP4 quantization and QAD.

recommendation.zh: RL 后训练模型在蒸馏中表征退化更严重——这对 pretrain-post-train 接口有直接启示；重点读 §3 CKA 分析。
recommendation.en: RL-post-trained models suffer more representational degradation during distillation — directly relevant to the pretrain-post-train interface; focus on §3 CKA analysis.

paper.title: FSA-GRPO: Teaching Auditory LLMs to Use Few-shot Demonstrations
paper.abstract: Few-shot prompting provides an effective way to adapt auditory large language models to low-resource tasks such as children's speech recognition. However, most auditory large language models are not explicitly trained to perform inference in this demonstration-conditioned format, limiting the extent to which they can benefit from few-shot prompting. To address this limitation, we introduce Few-Shot Aware GRPO (FSA-GRPO), an RL-based post-training recipe that uses a specially designed reward to e

summary.core_problem: 听觉LLM在低资源场景（如儿童语音识别）下性能大幅下降，而Few-shot prompting是有效的适应手段，但大多数听觉LLM未经过显式训练以利用demonstration-conditioned推理格式，限制了Few-shot收益。同时，直接在few-shot格式数据上做post-training存在两个风险：牺牲零样本能力、或仅学会训练任务的few-shot格式结构而非通用的demonstration利用能力。
summary.importance: 首次将RL-based post-training用于优化语音领域的in-context learning能力。对预训练研究的启发在于：GRPO+辅助奖励的方式可以在不损害零样本能力的前提下强化模型对demonstration的利用，这一思路可能迁移到文本LLM的ICL能力优化中。仅用高资源ASR数据训练就能泛化到多个语音理解任务，说明ICL能力可以通过RL跨任务迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Few-Shot Aware GRPO（FSA-GRPO）：1) 从高资源ASR数据（Common Voice英文子集）构造few-shot训练实例，将开发集作为查询集、训练集作为demonstration pool；2) 每个训练步骤采样查询音频+转录，并从pool中检索k=3个in-context demonstration；3) 双重奖励设计：主奖励基于WER衡量转录准确性（允许模型在有用时利用demonstration、无用时忽略），辅助奖励基于与demonstration的语义对齐鼓励模型利用demonstration；4) 研究了数据选择策略以提高训练效率，以及辅助奖励权重的影响。
summary.experiments: 主要实验设置：训练仅用Common Voice英文子集的高资源ASR数据；GRPO训练采样2k个查询实例；在儿童语音识别（低资源）和其他held-out语音/音频理解任务上测试；对比直接在相关跨域ASR数据上fine-tuning的baseline。结果显示FSA-GRPO在低资源ASR评估中比直接fine-tuning更有效，同时保持零样本推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，约25分钟。重点看：第3章Methodology中的奖励设计细节（尤其是辅助奖励的具体形式）；Algorithm 1的训练流程概括；第4.4节的数据选择策略分析。对预训练研究者，核心启发是GRPO+辅助奖励优化ICL能力的思路，可关注奖励设计的权衡。
summary.authors_note: 机构未在提供内容中明确，作者来自语音LLM研究社区。

summary_en.core_problem: Auditory LLMs degrade substantially in low-resource settings (e.g., child speech recognition). Few-shot prompting is a promising adaptation strategy, but most auditory LLMs are not explicitly trained for demonstration-conditioned inference, limiting few-shot benefits. Directly post-training on few-shot formatted data risks sacrificing zero-shot capability or learning only the format structure rather than general demonstration utilization.
summary_en.importance: First RL-based post-training approach for optimizing speech in-context learning. For pretraining research, the idea of using GRPO with an auxiliary demonstration-aware reward to strengthen ICL without damaging zero-shot performance could transfer to text LLM ICL optimization. Training on only high-resource ASR data generalizes to multiple speech tasks, suggesting ICL capability is transferable across tasks via RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: FSA-GRPO: 1) Construct few-shot training instances from high-resource ASR (Common Voice English): dev split as query set, train split as demonstration pool. 2) At each step, sample a query audio+transcript and retrieve k=3 in-context demonstrations. 3) Dual reward: primary reward based on WER for transcription accuracy (allows ignoring demonstrations when useless), auxiliary reward for semantic alignment with demonstrations to encourage utilization. 4) Data selection strategies for efficiency and analysis of auxiliary reward weight impact.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on 2k query instances from Common Voice English only; evaluated on child speech recognition (low-resource) and held-out audio/speech understanding tasks. FSA-GRPO outperforms direct fine-tuning on related out-of-domain ASR data in low-resource settings while preserving zero-shot inference capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, ~25 minutes. Focus on: Section 3 reward design details (especially the auxiliary reward form); Algorithm 1 training procedure summary; Section 4.4 data selection analysis. For pretraining researchers, the key takeaway is the GRPO+auxiliary-reward paradigm for ICL optimization—note the reward design tradeoffs.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided content; authors from speech LLM research community.

recommendation.zh: 把“会不会用few-shot示例”做成可优化的奖励信号，这个角度够实用；只需盯住reward定义与消融，别期待它回答预训练范式问题。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about making in-context demonstration usage an explicit reward target; focus on the reward design/ablations, not as evidence about pretraining paradigms.

paper.title: Faster Synchronous On-Policy RL via Straggler-Aware Group Sizing
paper.abstract: Synchronous reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provide stable and reproducible on-policy training, but they are highly vulnerable to stragglers, a single unusually long rollout can delay reward computation and parameter updates for the entire group. This problem becomes more severe as group size increases, creating a tension between the benefits of larger groups and the wall-clock cost of synchronization stalls. We propose Straggler-Aware Group Contr

summary.core_problem: 同步在线RL训练（如GRPO/DAPO）中，rollout生成长度的高方差导致严重的掉队者（straggler）问题：组内单次超长rollout会延迟整个组的奖励计算和参数更新，造成GPU空闲浪费。这一问题随组规模增大而恶化，使得增大组规模以提升优势估计质量的目标与实际壁钟效率之间存在根本矛盾。
summary.importance: 直接面向大规模RL后训练（特别是推理模型的RLVR训练）的系统优化。随着RL在基座模型后训练中的比重越来越高（如DeepSeek-R1报告RL计算量约为预训练的3%），rollout推理已占端到端训练延迟的80%。SAGC提出将组规模从静态超参数转化为自适应控制问题，这一思路对降低大规模RL训练成本有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Straggler-Aware Group Control (SAGC)，一个在线动态调整训练组规模的控制器。核心思想是将掉队者的形成视为一个概率事件，其可能性依赖于组规模和近期生成统计量。SAGC将组规模选择建模为在线带约束优化问题：在训练过程中学习掉队者概率与组规模的关系，主动避免容易导致同步停滞的配置，同时在生成方差较低时利用更大的组规模来保持优势估计质量。这种方法不需要放松同步约束（即保持严格on-policy），也不需要修改RL算法本身，仅在组分配层面做动态调整。
summary.experiments: 在GRPO和DAPO两种训练范式下，针对两个模型族进行评估，对比静态组规模基线以及基于OpenRLHF的工程化同步基线。结果显示：(i) SAGC减少掉队事件并提升壁钟效率，同时达到有竞争力或更优的训练奖励；(ii) 这些收益传递到最终模型质量——在下游推理基准上SAGC与最优静态组规模设置相当或更好；(iii) SAGC在没有显式长度惩罚的情况下，倾向于生成更短的输出，暗示掉队者感知控制能隐式抑制不必要的长生成。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction（问题动机，特别是关于RL后训练计算剖面的分析）和 SAGC的核心算法描述（应在 Section 2-3）。实验部分关注组规模动态调整的可视化和壁钟加速比数据。预计阅读时间：30-45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供内容确认具体机构和作者

summary_en.core_problem: In synchronous on-policy RL training (e.g., GRPO, DAPO), high variance in rollout generation lengths causes a severe straggler problem: a single abnormally long rollout delays reward computation and parameter updates for the entire group, creating GPU idle bubbles. This problem worsens with larger group sizes, creating a fundamental tension between increasing group size for better advantage estimation quality and actual wall-clock efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Directly addresses a systems-level bottleneck in large-scale RL post-training, particularly for reasoning models trained with RLVR. As RL accounts for an increasing share of end-to-end model training (DeepSeek-R1 reported RL compute at ~3% of pretraining), and rollout inference already contributes ~80% of training latency, SAGC's framing of group sizing as an adaptive control problem has practical implications for reducing the cost of large-scale RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Straggler-Aware Group Control (SAGC) is a dynamic controller that adapts training group size online based on observed rollout behavior. The core idea is to treat straggler formation as a probabilistic event whose likelihood depends on group size and recent generation statistics. SAGC formulates group-size selection as an online constrained optimization problem: it learns the relationship between straggler probability and group size during training, proactively avoiding configurations likely to cause synchronization stalls while still exploiting larger groups when generation variance is low. This approach preserves strict on-policy synchronization and requires no changes to the RL algorithm itself—it operates purely at the group assignment level.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated under both GRPO and DAPO training on two model families, compared against static group-size baselines and a strong engineered synchronous baseline built with OpenRLHF. Results show: (i) SAGC reduces straggler incidence and improves wall-clock efficiency while achieving competitive or better training reward; (ii) these benefits transfer to final model quality, matching or exceeding the best static group-size setting on downstream reasoning benchmarks; (iii) SAGC produces shorter outputs on downstream tasks without explicit length penalty, suggesting straggler-aware control implicitly discourages unnecessarily long generations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction (problem motivation, especially the analysis of RL post-training compute profile) and the core SAGC algorithm description (likely Sections 2-3). For experiments, look for visualizations of dynamic group size adaptation and wall-clock speedup data. Estimated reading time: 30-45 min.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和吞吐曲线即可；如果内部 GRPO 还用固定 group size，这篇值得马上复现小规模 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method and throughput curves; if your GRPO stack still uses fixed group sizes, this deserves a small internal ablation.

paper.title: LaRA: Layer-wise Representation Analysis for Detecting Data Contamination in RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has shown to improve reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, there has been little exploration on the problem of data contamination in RL post-training, potentially undermining generalization and evaluation reliability of the training process itself. Existing detection methods primarily rely on output-level signals such as likelihood or entropy, which become unreliable for RL-trained models since RL shapes behavior through trajectory-level re

summary.core_problem: RL post-training 阶段的数据污染检测是一个尚未充分探索的问题——现有的基于输出似然/熵的检测方法在 RL 训练模型上不可靠，因为 RL 通过轨迹级奖励塑造行为，而非 token 级似然优化，导致输出分布校准差。
summary.importance: 首次从表征层几何特征角度检测 RL 训练中的数据污染，避开了输出层信号不可靠的问题。对于 RL pretrain 过程中的数据质量监控、benchmark 泄露检测有直接应用价值。
summary.technical_approach: LaRA 将污染检测建模为成员推理攻击（MIA），利用模型内部表征对受控扰动的响应差异来区分训练见过的样本和未见过的样本。提出三个互补度量：(1) 表征偏移幅度（RSM）：移除关键信息时表征变化的剧烈程度；(2) 方向坍塌（DC）：表征变化是否收敛到共享主导方向；(3) 表征稳定性指数（RSI）：在保持语义不变的变体间表征的不变程度。通过构建语义相似的结构对照组和一致的信息掩码操作，分析跨层表征动力学。
summary.experiments: 在 EURUS-2-7B-PRIME、LIMR、Olmo-3.1-7B-RL-Zero-Math 三个开源 RL 训练模型上构建评估集（每个模型 30 个训练见过的样本 + 30 个未见过的 AIME 2026 样本）。LaRA 的检测 AUC 相比最优的输出层基线最高提升 9.6%，TPR@FPR=5% 最高提升 3.5 倍。进一步通过在受控语料上继续 RL 训练，追踪了成员/非成员信号在训练过程中的动态分化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 章三个度量的定义和直觉解释、第 4 章实验设计（特别是如何构建可控污染 benchmark）。对表征几何和 memorization 机制感兴趣的可以关注不同层的信号差异分析。预计阅读时间 25-30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Data contamination detection in RL post-training is an underexplored problem—existing likelihood/entropy-based detection methods fail on RL-trained models because RL shapes behavior through trajectory-level rewards rather than token-level likelihood optimization, resulting in poorly calibrated output distributions.
summary_en.importance: First approach to detect data contamination in RL training from the perspective of representation geometry, bypassing unreliable output-layer signals. Has direct applications for data quality monitoring and benchmark leak detection in RL pretrain pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaRA frames contamination detection as Membership Inference Attack (MIA), exploiting differential responses of internal representations to controlled perturbations to distinguish training-seen from unseen samples. Three complementary metrics: (1) Representation Shift Magnitude (RSM): how strongly representations change when critical information is removed; (2) Directional Collapse (DC): whether representation changes converge to shared dominant directions; (3) Representation Stability Index (RSI): how invariant representations remain across meaning-preserving variants. Uses structurally matched control groups of semantically similar questions and consistent information masking to analyze layer-wise representation dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation sets constructed on three open-source RL-trained models (EURUS-2-7B-PRIME, LIMR, Olmo-3.1-7B-RL-Zero-Math), each with 30 training-member samples and 30 unseen AIME 2026 samples. LaRA achieves up to +9.6% AUC improvement and 3.5x higher TPR@FPR=5% compared to the strongest output-level baseline. Additional controlled experiments track the divergence of member/non-member signals during continued RL training on a 1000-sample corpus.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for metric definitions and intuition, and Section 4 for experimental design (especially the controlled contamination benchmark construction). For those interested in representation geometry and memorization mechanisms, the layer-wise signal analysis is noteworthy. Expected reading time: 25-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和污染几何信号即可；如果结果稳，RLVR 数据去重不能再只靠输出概率。
recommendation.en: Read the method and geometry metrics; if robust, RLVR contamination checks should not rely only on output likelihood.

paper.title: OISD: On-Policy Internal Self-Distillation of Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning (RL) post-training approaches primarily optimize the final output policy using sparse outcome-level rewards, while largely overlooking predictive signals encoded in intermediate representations. In this paper, we introduce a new paradigm called on-policy internal self-distillation and propose the OISD framework, which improves reasoning by transferring on-policy predictive signals from the final layer to intermediate representations. During rollout and Group Relativ

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 reasoning RL 只优化最终输出、内部层缺少密集训练信号的问题。GRPO 这类 RLVR 方法能用结果奖励提升推理能力，但奖励稀疏，且梯度主要围绕最终 acting policy 展开。论文希望把最终层已经形成的预测分布和注意力模式，转化为中间层的训练信号。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-train 方法论文，但对预训练研究有两点启发。第一，它把 logit lens 从分析工具变成训练目标，说明中间层预测分布可以作为可优化对象。第二，它提供了一种不依赖外部 teacher 的 dense supervision 方案，可能迁移到预训练或 mid-training：让深层预测监督浅层/中层表示，改善表示形成速度和层间计算分工。贡献量级更接近一个清晰的训练目标设计，而不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: OISD 在标准 decoder-only Transformer 内做“纵向”自蒸馏。训练时仍只用最终层作为 rollout policy，并用 GRPO 做策略优化；同时把最终层的输出 detach，作为内部 teacher。选定某个中间层后，使用模型共享的 unembedding matrix 将该层 hidden state 投影到 token space，得到一个 auxiliary student。student 接收两类监督：logit alignment 对齐最终层的 token 分布，用来传递“下一步该倾向哪些 token”的预测信念；attention alignment 对齐最终层的注意力模式，用来传递“当前 token 应该关注哪些上下文位置”的证据路由。这样做和 off-policy distillation 的区别是轨迹来自当前模型自己，而不是外部 teacher；和普通 on-policy distillation 的区别是 teacher 不是另一个模型或 privileged prompt，而是同一模型的最终层；和 latent reasoning 的区别是它不增加额外推理 token 或 recurrent hidden steps，只利用已有层间计算。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在四个数学推理 benchmark 上，相对强 GRPO baseline 有稳定提升。关键实验重点不在扩大模型或数据，而在验证内部监督是否提供额外增益。消融方向包括：只做 logit alignment、只做 attention alignment、二者结合、不同中间层选择、是否 detach 最终层 teacher、以及与常规 GRPO 的对比。给出的全文片段没有包含具体模型规模、训练 token 数、benchmark 名称和提升数值，因此这里不补写不可核查数字。可确认的结论是，logit 对齐和 attention 对齐被设计为互补信号，前者约束预测分布，后者约束上下文依赖结构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 on-policy internal self-distillation 的定义，确认它和外部 teacher 蒸馏、privileged self-distillation、latent reasoning 的边界。然后看方法部分的损失函数：重点是最终层如何 detach、中间层如何通过 unembedding 得到 logits、logit alignment 和 attention alignment 如何加到 GRPO objective 上。实验部分优先看主结果表和 ablation 表，尤其是中间层选择与 loss 权重敏感性。如果关心预训练，可重点思考这个目标是否会破坏深浅层的自然分工，以及在 pretrain 中是否需要 warmup 后再加，而不是从训练初期就强行对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of reasoning-oriented RL: GRPO-style training optimizes the final acting policy with sparse outcome rewards, while intermediate layers receive no direct dense signal about their predictive beliefs or attention behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training method, but it is relevant to pretraining research because it turns logit-lens-style intermediate predictions into trainable objects. It suggests a way to add dense internal supervision without an external teacher. The contribution is best viewed as a training-objective design for improving layerwise representation formation, rather than a new base-model pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: OISD keeps the final layer as the only rollout policy and optimizes it with GRPO. During the same on-policy rollout, the final layer is detached and used as an internal teacher. A selected intermediate layer is projected into token space through the shared unembedding matrix, forming an auxiliary internal student. The student is trained with two alignment losses. Logit alignment matches the final layer’s predictive distribution and transfers token-level reasoning preferences. Attention alignment matches the final layer’s attention patterns and transfers evidence-routing behavior. This differs from off-policy distillation because the trajectories are generated by the current model. It differs from typical on-policy distillation because there is no external teacher or privileged prompt. It also differs from latent reasoning methods because it does not add extra reasoning tokens or recurrent hidden-state steps.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains over strong GRPO baselines on four mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The main ablations examine logit alignment alone, attention alignment alone, their combination, the choice of intermediate layer, and the effect of detaching the final-layer teacher. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact model sizes, training data scale, benchmark names, or numerical improvements, so those numbers are not restated here. The reliable takeaway is that the two auxiliary losses target different aspects of the computation: predictive beliefs and attention routing.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction to pin down the definition of on-policy internal self-distillation and how it differs from external-teacher distillation, privileged self-distillation, and latent reasoning. Then focus on the method section: how the intermediate layer is projected with the unembedding matrix, how the final-layer teacher is detached, and how the two alignment losses are combined with GRPO. In the experiments, prioritize the main result table and ablations over benchmark-by-benchmark details. For pretraining-oriented readers, the key question is whether such layerwise alignment should be introduced only after representations have stabilized, instead of being applied from the start of training.

recommendation.zh: 读§方法和消融即可；若中间层蒸馏在GRPO下稳定有效，值得放进RL-pretrain接口实验。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if intermediate-layer distillation is stable under GRPO, it deserves a slot in RL-pretrain interface experiments.

paper.title: Retrieval, Reward, and Training Protocols: What Matters in Training Search Agents?
paper.abstract: Search agents powered by large language models can autonomously decompose queries, retrieve information, and synthesize answers through multi-step reasoning. However, the rapid growth of training methods has outpaced controlled comparison: existing works differ in retrieval corpora, reward designs, and training protocols, making it unclear what actually drives improvements. We present a controlled empirical study that isolates three under-explored dimensions of search agent training. First, we i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“哪种搜索 agent 训练算法更强”，而是一个更基础的问题：在搜索 agent 的 RL 训练里，真正决定效果的因素到底是什么。作者把常被混在一起比较的三类变量拆开了看：检索环境本身是否可靠、奖励与 credit assignment 设计是否真的带来稳定收益、以及训练数据组成和 off-policy 程度如何影响学习。全文最重要的发现是，很多已有结论可能建立在一个有缺陷的检索环境上：广泛使用的 Wikipedia 2018 语料存在明显覆盖缺失，导致 agent 明明策略合理却检索不到证据，训练时因此收到错误或噪声很大的反馈。这个问题如果不先修正，后续比较 reward 设计或 RL 算法，结论很容易失真。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在“搜索 agent”这个应用表面，而在训练信号质量这件事上。它提醒人注意：当模型学习依赖外部环境时，环境缺陷会被误当成算法差异；而在更一般的 pretrain / post-train 闭环里，这对应的是数据覆盖、标签可达性、奖励可辨识度这些更底层的问题。贡献类型主要是受控实验和训练 protocol 澄清，而不是新算法。量级上，它没有提出新的范式，但给出了一个很硬的结论：修正 retrieval corpus 的覆盖问题，带来的收益比几种主流 credit assignment 方法之间的差异还大。这类结果对做 RL、tool use、RAG 训练甚至合成数据管线的人都很有参考价值，因为它把“先把环境做对”放回了优先级更高的位置。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者刻意避免再引入新的训练技巧，而是把四种代表性方法放进同一个实现框架里做公平对照。四种方法分别对应不同 credit assignment 路线：Search-R1 用最简单的 outcome reward，只在轨迹末端按 EM 给一个整体奖励；GiGPO 通过状态相似性把不同轨迹中的步骤对齐，做跨轨迹的 step-level advantage；IGPO 用每一步对 ground-truth log-prob 的变化作为启发式过程奖励；Tree-GRPO 则通过树式展开构造共享前缀的分支，在分叉点做更自然的局部比较。关键点不在这些方法本身，而在作者把它们统一到同一个 GRPO 目标、同一套 Verl 代码、同一训练集和评测集上，尽量消掉基础设施差异。

全文真正的技术重心有三块。第一块是 retrieval environment 审计。作者检查了常用 Wikipedia 2018 语料，发现不少 benchmark 问题对应的关键证据段落根本不在库里，或者页面版本不完整，造成系统性 retrieval failure。于是他们构建了覆盖更完整的检索库，并用这个修正后的环境重新训练和评测。第二块是 reward design 的受控比较。作者不只看最终答对率，还分析中间搜索行为，观察 process reward 是否真的让 agent 学到更好的检索和浏览策略。第三块是训练 protocol 分析，包括训练数据混合、off-policy 数据使用比例、以及训练和推理时 search budget 的伸缩关系。这里的思路很像做 pretrain recipe ablation：不是问某个 fancy 方法能不能赢，而是问哪些变量是一级因素，哪些只是二级修饰。
summary.experiments:
实验设置比较扎实。训练集统一从 HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2WikiMultihopQA 中随机抽取总计 9,000 条样本；评测覆盖 HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle、PopQA，共 4,125 条测试样本。作者还在三种 base models 上比较 outcome reward 与多种 process reward，这一点有助于避免“某个结论只对单一底模成立”。

从全文给出的主结果看，最重要的不是某个算法领先多少，而是排序关系：修复 Wikipedia 2018 覆盖问题后，整体性能提升幅度超过不同训练算法之间的差距。也就是说，过去一些方法差异，可能只是建立在不同程度的 retrieval miss 上。奖励设计方面，最简单的 outcome-based 方法在大多数设置下与 process-based 方法持平，甚至更好；复杂的 step-level credit assignment 并没有稳定兑现其理论优势。作者进一步分析中间行为后发现，process reward 往往会“纠偏过度”：它可能改善某一类局部行为，比如更积极地扩展搜索或更快聚焦证据，但同时损伤另一类能力，比如保留探索多样性或避免过早收缩。训练数据和 off-policy 分析则给出更实用的结论：数据多样性通常比复杂 credit heuristic 更稳；off-policy 使用存在有效区间，过高会引入分布偏移；search budget 在训练和推理阶段都重要，但收益不是线性增长，需要和策略成熟度一起看。

由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，无法在这里逐项复述所有绝对分数；但从作者反复强调的结果强度看，‘环境覆盖修正 > 算法差异’是整篇最该记住的实验结论。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先抓三部分。第一，Introduction 里对问题设定的界定要认真看，它解释了为什么 search agent 比 coding agent 更难做公平比较：不是模型不同，而是环境、工具接口、动作空间都没标准化。第二，实验设置部分要看清四种方法在统一 GRPO 框架下是怎么被重写的，这决定了后面比较是否可信。第三，优先看 retrieval corpus 问题和中间行为分析相关的图表，这两处最有信息量。

如果时间有限，阅读顺序可以是：Introduction → retrieval environment 结果 → reward design 主表 → 行为分析/ablation → training protocol 讨论，预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要结论。值得深挖的点有两个：一是作者如何定义“缺失证据”以及如何验证它确实改变了训练信号；二是 process reward 的副作用具体体现在哪些搜索行为统计上，这对设计 tool-use RL 的奖励很有借鉴意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more fundamental question than “which search-agent algorithm works best”: what actually drives performance in RL training for search agents once retrieval environment, reward design, and training protocol are disentangled. The central issue identified in the full paper is that many prior comparisons are confounded by the retrieval setup itself. A widely used Wikipedia 2018 corpus has substantial coverage gaps, so agents often fail to retrieve supporting evidence even when their behavior is reasonable. That creates spurious negative signals during training and makes downstream algorithm comparisons unreliable.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is not limited to search agents. The paper is really about training signal quality under environment-mediated learning. It shows that environment defects can dominate apparent algorithmic gains, which maps directly to broader concerns in pretraining and post-training: data coverage, answerability, reward observability, and whether the model is being penalized for missing information rather than poor policy. The contribution is empirical clarification rather than a new method. The strongest takeaway is concrete and high-leverage: fixing retrieval coverage yields larger gains than switching among several popular credit-assignment methods. That is a useful lesson for RL, tool-use training, RAG pipelines, and synthetic-data systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is deliberately designed as a controlled comparison rather than a proposal of another training algorithm. Four representative methods are re-implemented under the same GRPO-style objective and the same Verl codebase: Search-R1 as a pure outcome-reward baseline with trajectory-level credit only; GiGPO with cross-trajectory step grouping based on state similarity; IGPO with heuristic per-turn rewards derived from changes in ground-truth log-probability; and Tree-GRPO with branch-based local comparisons from shared prefixes. The point is not to showcase these methods individually, but to remove implementation and infrastructure variance so that credit-assignment choices can be compared more cleanly.

The technical substance of the paper has three parts. First, it audits the retrieval environment and documents missing relevant passages in the standard Wikipedia 2018 setup, then constructs a more complete corpus and reruns training/evaluation under that corrected environment. Second, it compares outcome-based and process-based rewards not only on final QA accuracy but also on intermediate search behavior, which is important because process rewards are supposed to shape search trajectories rather than just final answers. Third, it studies training protocol variables: data diversity, degree of off-policy usage, and search-budget scaling at both training and inference time. This makes the paper closer to a recipe study than an algorithm paper: it identifies first-order versus second-order factors in search-agent learning.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is reasonably controlled. Training uses a unified set of 9,000 examples sampled from HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and 2WikiMultihopQA. Evaluation spans HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, Bamboogle, and PopQA, for a total of 4,125 test instances. The reward comparison is also run across three base models, which helps avoid overfitting conclusions to a single backbone.

The most important result is qualitative but strong: correcting retrieval coverage in Wikipedia 2018 produces larger gains than the differences among the compared training algorithms. That means some previously reported method advantages may have been artifacts of retrieval misses rather than better learning. On reward design, the simplest outcome-based method is competitive with, and often better than, more elaborate process-reward methods across most settings. The paper’s behavior analysis suggests why: process-level credit assignment can over-correct. It may improve one local aspect of search, such as more targeted evidence gathering, while hurting another, such as exploration diversity or robustness against premature narrowing. The protocol analysis further indicates that data diversity is a more reliable lever than sophisticated credit heuristics, that off-policy data has a useful but limited range before distribution mismatch becomes harmful, and that search budget matters in both training and inference but does not scale linearly with returns.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include all numeric tables, so it is not possible to reproduce every absolute score here. Still, the headline experimental conclusion is clear and well supported: retrieval-environment quality dominates algorithmic differences.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the Introduction carefully because it explains why search agents are unusually hard to compare fairly: unlike coding agents, their environment, tool interface, and action granularity are not standardized. Second, inspect the experimental setup to see how the four methods are normalized into one GRPO framework; that is what makes the later comparison credible. Third, prioritize the sections and figures on retrieval-corpus defects and intermediate behavior analysis, since those contain the most actionable insights.

A good reading order is: Introduction → retrieval environment results → main reward-design table → behavior analysis/ablations → training-protocol discussion. That should take about 25–35 minutes. Two points are worth deeper attention: how the paper defines and verifies missing evidence in the corpus, and which concrete search-behavior statistics reveal the downside of process rewards. Both are useful if you work on RL for tool use or environment-grounded LMs.

recommendation.zh: 读数据覆盖和 reward ablation；若结果站得住，内部 search-agent RL 应先查 corpus，再谈复杂 PRM。
recommendation.en: Read the corpus-coverage and reward ablations; if the setup is clean, search-agent RL should audit retrieval data before adding complex PRMs.

paper.title: Scaling Behaviors of LLM Reinforcement Learning Post-Training: An Empirical Study in Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: While scaling laws for large language models (LLMs) during pre-training have been extensively studied, their behavior under reinforcement learning (RL) post-training remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic empirical investigation of scaling behaviors in RL-based post-training, with a particular focus on mathematical reasoning. Based on a set of experiments across the full Qwen2.5 dense model series (0.5B to 72B), we characterize how model scale, data volume, and computationa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RL post-training 在数学推理上的 scaling 行为：给定模型规模、RL 计算量、可用题目数量和数据复用强度，模型的 Pass Rate 改善是否存在可预测规律。它关心的不是某个 RL recipe 的单点效果，而是类似预训练 scaling law 的资源分配问题：在固定 FLOPs、固定唯一数据量、或固定总训练样本量时，应当选择多大的模型、训练多久、是否重复使用数据。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值在于，它把 post-train RL 从经验配方推进到可量化的资源规划问题。预训练 scaling law 通常用 loss、参数量、token 数和 compute 建模；这篇工作把类似思想放到 reasoning RL，使用 1 - PassRate 作为 test loss，分析模型规模和 RL 资源之间的关系。最有用的结论有三点：第一，大模型在 RL 阶段也更 compute-efficient 和 data-efficient，不只是初始能力更强；第二，这种效率提升有饱和趋势，不能简单外推为参数越大越划算；第三，在数据受限时，重复使用小规模高质量题目接近使用更大语料的效果。这对 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-train、以及后训练预算分配都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较干净。作者选用 Qwen2.5 同构模型族，覆盖 0.5B、1.5B、3B、7B、14B、32B、72B，尽量让参数规模成为主要变量。RL 训练使用 VeRL 框架，训练数据来自 Reasoning360 的 guru-RL-92k 数学子集，并经过去重和难度过滤；题目按 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 pass rate 从易到难排序，用作 curriculum。评测分两类：一类是 500 道同分布 held-out math problems，用于拟合和验证 scaling 公式；另一类是更宽的泛化评测，包括 AIME2024、AMC2023、GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、Zebra Puzzle、SuperGPQA。核心建模是把 RL 后的 test loss 写成模型规模 N 和资源预算 X 的函数，其中 X 可以是 compute C 或数据量 D。经验上，loss 随资源预算呈近似 log-linear 的下降；斜率可理解为学习效率 k(N)。进一步，k(N) 随模型规模增大而提高，但以饱和函数逼近上限 K_max，表示大模型的边际 RL 效率收益会递减。这个设定比简单拟合每个模型的学习曲线更有解释力，因为它同时回答了“同样预算给哪个尺寸”和“继续加大模型是否还划算”。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是这篇论文的主要支撑。作者在 Qwen2.5 0.5B 到 72B 上训练了 63 个 RL 模型，使用超过 50k 道数学题。主要结果显示，在 0.5B–72B 范围内，RL 带来的 loss reduction 与 compute 大致满足 log-linear 趋势；大模型不仅起点更好，单位 compute 和单位数据带来的提升也更高。论文还比较了 base model 和 instruct model，报告所提出的 power-law 形式在两类初始化上都具有预测性，能够外推较大模型表现和训练后期轨迹。数据受限实验显示，重复曝光较小数据集的效果接近使用更多唯一题目，说明对 math RL 来说，高质量题目的 reuse 是有效策略。附录还分析了 GRPO 中 rollout number 的影响，用于理解采样数量对 RL 学习效率和稳定性的作用。给定片段没有提供具体 benchmark 分数和拟合参数，因此不应过度解读绝对提升幅度；更可靠的结论是趋势、相对效率和可预测性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读实验设置、scaling law 公式和三组资源约束实验。优先看：1）模型族、数据、curriculum 和评测协议，判断变量控制是否足够干净；2）loss versus compute/data 的主图，重点看不同模型尺寸的斜率差异；3）k(N) 饱和拟合，判断 32B 到 72B 的边际收益是否已经明显下降；4）data-constrained 和 data reuse 实验，因为这部分最接近实际 RL 数据预算决策；5）base 与 instruct 初始化的对比，理解预训练/指令调优状态如何影响 RL scaling；6）GRPO rollout number 的附录，关注采样预算与学习信号质量之间的关系。深挖时要特别注意两个限制：数学题 reward 相对清晰，结论未必直接迁移到开放式偏好 RL；使用 Qwen2.5 单一模型族有利于控制变量，但也限制了架构和 tokenizer 差异下的外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether RL post-training for mathematical reasoning has predictable scaling behavior. The central question is how model size, RL compute, unique training problems, and data reuse interact when the target metric is pass-rate improvement rather than pretraining cross-entropy. It frames RL post-training as a resource allocation problem: under fixed FLOPs, fixed unique data, or fixed total sample budget, which model size and training regime should be preferred.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical scaling study for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It extends the scaling-law mindset from pretraining loss to reasoning RL, using 1 - PassRate as a test loss. The useful signal is not just that larger models perform better after RL, but that they learn more efficiently during RL as well. At the same time, the efficiency gain appears to saturate with scale, so the result does not support a naive “larger is always proportionally better” extrapolation. The data reuse finding is also practically relevant: when high-quality reasoning problems are scarce, repeated exposure to a smaller curated set can be close to using a larger pool of unique problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study controls model-family variation by using Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B parameters: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B. RL runs are conducted with VeRL. The training set is the math subset of guru-RL-92k from Reasoning360, after deduplication and difficulty filtering. Problems are sorted by increasing difficulty using the pass rate of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, forming a curriculum. Evaluation has two layers: a 500-problem in-domain held-out set for fitting and validating the scaling relation, and a broader benchmark suite covering AIME2024, AMC2023, GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval, Zebra Puzzle, and SuperGPQA. The proposed formulation models post-RL test loss as a function of model size N and a resource budget X, where X can be compute or data. Empirically, loss decreases approximately log-linearly with the resource budget. The slope is interpreted as a learning-efficiency term k(N), and k(N) increases with model size but approaches a saturation limit K_max. This is the key modeling choice: it separates initial capability from RL learning efficiency and makes diminishing returns explicit.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical base consists of 63 RL-trained LLMs across the Qwen2.5 scale range, trained on more than 50k math problems. The main observation is that, from 0.5B to 72B, RL-induced loss reduction follows an approximately log-linear trend with compute. Larger models start stronger and also gain more per unit of compute and per unit of data. The paper reports that the same power-law style relation is predictive for both base and instruction-tuned initializations, including extrapolation to larger models and later training stages. In the data-limited regime, reusing a smaller set of problems is nearly as effective as increasing the number of unique problems under comparable total exposure. The appendix also studies the number of rollouts in GRPO, which is relevant for separating sample budget from reward-signal quality. The provided text does not expose exact benchmark scores or fitted coefficients, so the robust takeaway is the shape of the scaling behavior rather than a specific numerical improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the experimental setup first, especially the model family, curriculum construction, reward/evaluation protocol, and the distinction between in-domain scaling validation and out-of-domain generalization. Then focus on the main loss-versus-compute and loss-versus-data plots, looking at slope differences across model sizes. The most important figure is the saturation fit for k(N), because it determines whether scaling RL to larger models remains cost-effective. The data-constrained and data-reuse sections are worth close reading for practical training decisions. Also inspect the comparison between base and instruction-tuned initializations, since it indicates how much the RL scaling law depends on the starting policy. The GRPO rollout-number ablation is useful for understanding whether more samples improve learning by reducing variance or by changing the exploration distribution.

recommendation.zh: 要读：它把 RLVR 拉进 scaling-law 框架，尤其应复现 k(N) 饱和项，避免把大模型 RL 效率外推得过满。
recommendation.en: Read it for the k(N) saturation result; the setup is narrow, but it is a useful guardrail against naive RLVR scale extrapolation.
