paper.title: Learn Where Outcomes Diverge: Efficient VLA RL via Probabilistic Chunk Masking
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) allows vision-language-action (VLA) policies to generalize beyond their training distribution by optimizing directly for task success, but post-training is computationally expensive. A natural response has been to speed rollout collection through faster simulators and world models. In GRPO-based VLA RL, we find that the dominant cost lies elsewhere: gradient computation accounts for approximately 78% of wall-clock time per step in our runs, while rollout collection ac

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决的是 VLA 的 GRPO 强化学习后训练效率问题。关键观察是，瓶颈不一定在 rollout 采样，而在 actor 更新的前后向计算。作者在自己的运行中测到，单步 wall-clock 中约 78% 花在梯度计算，约 21% 花在 rollout collection。问题因此变成：一条轨迹里的哪些 action chunk 值得参与反向传播，而不是默认对所有 chunk 都算梯度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不强，但对大模型后训练的 compute allocation 有启发。它把 RL 训练中的样本效率问题转成了梯度预算分配问题：不是只改 advantage 或 reward，而是减少无信息阶段的反向传播。这个视角对语言模型 RL、长轨迹 agent RL、tool-use RL 也有可迁移性，尤其是当奖励是 trajectory-level、有效 credit 只集中在少数决策点时。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Probabilistic Chunk Masking，作为 GRPO 的插拔式改造。轨迹先被切成 action chunks，并用确定性规则分到若干 semantic phases。普通 GRPO 会给同一条轨迹里的所有 chunk 分配同一个 group-relative advantage，并对所有 chunk 做反向传播。PCM 只保留固定预算内的 chunk 参与 actor update，未选中的 chunk 被物理移出 backward path，从而同时省计算和 activation memory。保留概率不是均匀采样，而是按 phase 的 outcome divergence 来分配。理论上，作者把每个 phase 的有效学习信号定义为 per-phase gradient variance V_c，并给出类似 Neyman allocation 的预算分配，比例为 N_c sqrt(V_c)。由于 V_c 不能直接低成本获得，作者用成功 rollout 与失败 rollout 在该 phase 上的 action variance C_c 作为代理，并证明 C_c 可作为 V_c 的可测 lower-bound proxy。这个设计区别于 PPO critic 或 per-step credit assignment：后者主要改变学习信号，PCM 改变哪些位置获得梯度计算。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 LIBERO VLA 任务上。作者报告 PCM 使用每条轨迹少于 20% 的 chunks，达到 98% convergence 的 wall-clock 时间加速 2.38 倍，梯度步骤本身加速 4.8 倍，peak activation memory 降低 60%。这些数字支持一个核心结论：在该设置里，减少 backward 覆盖范围比继续优化 rollout 采样更有效。消融重点应是 phase-level variance 是否真的集中、C_c 与真实梯度方差 V_c 的相关性、固定预算下按 C_c 分配是否优于 uniform masking 或随机 chunk masking。给出的正文片段表明作者强调 outcome-critical semantic phases 的稀疏性，但完整实验表中的任务级成功率、不同 chunk budget、不同 phase labeling 规则的鲁棒性需要进一步核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 里的 cost breakdown，确认 78% 梯度计算占比是否来自目标运行设置；再看 Methodology 中 V_c、C_c 和 Neyman allocation 的定义，重点理解为什么 action variance 能作为 gradient variance 的代理；最后看 LIBERO 实验中的 chunk budget、收敛曲线、memory 曲线和 masking 消融。若关心 LLM RL，可重点抽象出一个问题：长轨迹中哪些 token 或 action step 应该进入 backward，而不仅是如何给所有 token 分配 advantage。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the training cost of GRPO-based reinforcement learning for vision-language-action policies. Its main observation is that rollout collection is not the dominant bottleneck in the authors’ setup. Gradient computation accounts for about 78% of per-step wall-clock time, while rollout collection accounts for about 21%. The practical question is therefore which chunks inside a trajectory should receive backpropagation, rather than assuming that every chunk deserves gradient compute.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining contribution, but it gives a useful compute-allocation view for large-model RL. It treats gradient computation as a scarce resource and allocates it to trajectory segments where success and failure actually diverge. This is relevant beyond robotics: long-horizon language-agent RL, tool-use training, and trajectory-level reward optimization often have sparse decision points, while standard policy-gradient implementations still backpropagate through many low-signal tokens or steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Probabilistic Chunk Masking, is a drop-in modification to chunk-level GRPO. A trajectory is divided into action chunks, and chunks are assigned to deterministic semantic phases. Standard GRPO applies the same group-relative advantage across all chunks in a trajectory and computes gradients everywhere. PCM instead keeps only a fixed budget of chunks and physically removes the rest from the backward pass. The keep probability is phase-dependent. The paper defines the useful signal of a phase as its per-phase gradient variance V_c and derives a Neyman-style allocation proportional to N_c sqrt(V_c). Since V_c is expensive to measure directly, PCM uses the action variance between successful and failed rollouts, C_c, as a measurable proxy. The authors argue and prove that C_c lower-bounds the relevant gradient-variance signal under their assumptions. The key distinction from critic-based credit assignment is that PCM changes compute placement, not only the scalar learning signal.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported evaluation is on LIBERO. PCM uses less than 20% of trajectory chunks, reaches 98% convergence with a 2.38x wall-clock speedup, makes gradient steps 4.8x faster, and reduces peak activation memory by 60%. These results support the claim that, in this VLA RL regime, actor-update compute is the right target for optimization. The most informative ablations are the concentration of phase-level variance, the quality of C_c as a proxy for V_c, and comparisons against uniform or random chunk masking under the same chunk budget. The supplied text does not expose all task-level tables, so final confidence should depend on how robust the gains are across tasks, budgets, and phase-labeling rules.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the cost breakdown in the introduction, because the method is only compelling if gradient computation is indeed the dominant cost. Then read the definitions of V_c, C_c, and the Neyman allocation in the methodology. Finally inspect the LIBERO convergence curves, memory measurements, and masking ablations. For LLM RL readers, the transferable idea is selective backpropagation over long trajectories, rather than another variant of advantage normalization.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 profiling 和 masking 规则：78% 梯度开销这个数会改变 VLA RL 优化优先级，但需警惕任务规模是否偏小。
recommendation.en: Read the profiling and masking rule: the 78% gradient-cost number changes VLA RL optimization priorities, though task scale may be the weak point.

paper.title: MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs
paper.abstract: We present MindLab Toolkit (MinT), a managed infrastructure system for Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) post-training and online serving. MinT targets a setting where many trained policies are produced over a small number of expensive base-model deployments. Instead of materializing each policy as a merged full checkpoint, MinT keeps the base model resident and moves exported LoRA adapter revisions through rollout, update, export, evaluation, serving, and rollback, hiding distributed training, serving

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是大规模后训练和在线服务中的模型变体管理问题：当一个基座模型上存在大量 LoRA 策略、RL 实验分支、租户定制版本和回滚点时，传统复制完整 checkpoint 或合并 LoRA 后再服务的流程会在存储、带宽、调度和复现上变得很重。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练算法论文，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有实际启发。随着 RL、在线数据回流和持续训练变成常态，基座模型不再只是一次性训练产物，而是多个策略版本共享的 resident base。MinT 的核心价值在于把 LoRA adapter 作为可训练、可导出、可服务、可回滚的策略单元，减少训练到服务之间移动的对象大小，并让多策略 RL 可以共享同一基座部署。这类基础设施会影响后训练实验速度、reward 迭代频率和策略版本可追踪性。
summary.technical_approach: MinT 采用 adapter-centered workflow。基座模型常驻训练或推理引擎，行为差异由 LoRA adapter 表示。训练完成后，系统不导出完整模型，也不强制合并 LoRA，而是生成 serving-compatible adapter revision。这个 revision 包含固定训练步的 LoRA 权重、服务端张量布局、与 resident base 的兼容性信息、rollout 记录、评测和服务归因信息。系统层面包含队列、准入、放置、故障恢复、adapter 生命周期管理、冷加载调度和回滚。训练侧支持单 worker PEFT 和分布式 Megatron 路径，可在共享基座上 time-slice 多个 LoRA RL 会话。服务侧基于 shared-base vLLM，多 adapter 通过 CPU/GPU hot working set 管理，持久策略命名空间与实际引擎驻留集合分离。对 MoE LoRA，工作使用 packed tensor 表示减少大量小对象加载带来的开销。
summary.experiments: 报告给出三条扩展轴上的系统结果。Scale Up：支持 frontier-scale dense 和 MoE 架构，验证到超过 1T total parameters；还报告了 235B-A22B 规模训练和 1T-class MoE countdown-task 路径。Scale Down：adapter-only handoff 避免完整 checkpoint materialization；在 4B dense 模型上 handoff 步骤减少 18.3×，在 30B MoE 上减少 2.85×；在相同 resident-base allocation 下，并发 multi-policy GRPO 将 wall time 分别缩短 1.77× 和 1.45×，且不增加 peak memory。Scale Out：支持 10^6 级可寻址 policy catalog，单引擎扫过 100K entries，集群级支持 thousand-adapter active waves；packed MoE LoRA tensors 将 live engine loading 提升 8.5–8.7×。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 35–45 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 MinT 与 full fine-tuning、merge-based LoRA 的边界差异。然后看 adapter revision 的定义和生命周期，这部分决定了复现、回滚和在线服务如何接在一起。系统实现部分可重点看 scheduler、serving residency、cold loading 和 packed MoE LoRA 表示。实验部分重点记住 18.3×/2.85× handoff、1.77×/1.45× multi-policy GRPO、8.5–8.7× MoE adapter loading 这几组数字。若只关心预训练，可把它作为持续训练和 RL 实验平台设计的参考，而不是建模方法。
summary.authors_note: 机构显示为 Mind Lab；给定内容未包含作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses infrastructure for managing very large numbers of post-trained LLM variants. When many LoRA policies, RL branches, tenant-specific behaviors, and rollback points share the same base model, moving full checkpoints or serving merged LoRA checkpoints creates heavy storage, bandwidth, scheduling, and reproducibility costs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the interface between base models and continuous post-training. Modern RL and online training pipelines need fast iteration over policy populations that share a resident base model. MinT treats LoRA adapters as first-class policy units that can be trained, exported, served, evaluated, attributed, and rolled back. That changes the operational cost of RL loops and makes policy versioning more explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: MinT uses an adapter-centered workflow. The base model stays resident in training or inference deployments, while behavior changes are represented by LoRA adapters. After training, MinT exports a serving-compatible adapter revision instead of a full checkpoint or a merged model. A revision contains the frozen LoRA payload at a specific step, serving tensor layout, compatibility checks against the resident base, rollout records, evaluation and serving attribution, and rollback state. The system includes queueing, admission control, placement, fault tolerance, adapter lifecycle management, cold-load scheduling, and revision visibility. Training supports both single-worker PEFT and distributed Megatron paths, with time-sliced LoRA RL sessions over shared resident bases. Serving uses shared-base vLLM engines, separates durable policy addressability from CPU/GPU hot working sets, and schedules first-touch adapter loading. For MoE LoRA, packed tensors reduce small-object fanout during live loading.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are system-scale measurements. On the Scale Up axis, MinT is validated on dense and MoE deployments beyond 1T total parameters, including a 235B-A22B-scale training path and a 1T-class MoE countdown-task path. On Scale Down, adapter-only handoff avoids full-checkpoint materialization; the measured handoff step is reduced by 18.3× on a 4B dense model and 2.85× on a 30B MoE model. With the same resident-base allocation, concurrent multi-policy GRPO reduces wall time by 1.77× and 1.45× respectively without increasing peak memory. On Scale Out, the system supports 10^6-scale addressable policy catalogs, single-engine sweeps through 100K entries, and thousand-adapter active waves at cluster scale. Packed MoE LoRA tensors improve live engine loading by 8.5–8.7×.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 35–45 minutes. Start with Figures 1 and 2 to understand how MinT differs from full fine-tuning and merge-based LoRA deployment. Then read the adapter revision lifecycle, because that is where training, serving, evaluation, rollback, and reproducibility meet. In the system sections, focus on scheduling, serving residency, cold loading, and the packed MoE LoRA representation. The key numbers to retain are 18.3× and 2.85× handoff reduction, 1.77× and 1.45× multi-policy GRPO speedup, and 8.5–8.7× faster MoE adapter loading.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution shown in the provided content: Mind Lab. The author list is not included.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 ablation 数字即可；它提醒预训练团队别把 LoRA-RL 的瓶颈误判成训练算子问题。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and ablation numbers; it is a useful reminder that LoRA-RL bottlenecks can be lifecycle and data-movement issues, not just kernels.

paper.title: Reinforcing VLAs in Task-Agnostic World Models
paper.abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models via reinforcement learning (RL) in learned world models has emerged as an effective strategy to adapt to new tasks without costly real-world interactions. However, while using imagined trajectories reduces the sample complexity of policy training, existing methods still heavily rely on task-specific data to fine-tune both the world and reward models, fundamentally limiting their scalability to unseen tasks. To overcome this, we argue that world a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的机器人策略优化，而是一个更具体、也更卡脖子的问题：如何在目标任务完全未参与世界模型训练的前提下，用冻结的 world model 和冻结的 reward source，对新任务做高数据效率的 VLA 后训练。现有基于 imagined rollout 的 VLA-RL 方法虽然减少了真实交互，但 world model 往往仍要用目标任务数据重训或微调，reward 也常依赖任务专用分类器、参考轨迹或人工设计信号，所以一旦任务变了，整套流程都要重新收集数据。RAW-Dream 把这个依赖拆开：world model 只学任务无关的物理动态，reward 由通用 VLM 对 imagined video + instruction 做零样本判定，目标任务只需要少量 demonstration 把 policy 对齐到任务语义，再在梦境里做 RL。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于它提出了一个新的 backbone，而在于它把“可复用的 task-agnostic simulator”明确成了一个预训练对象，并给出了一条比 task-specific world-model RL 更干净的扩展路线。这里有三个层面的价值。第一，它把 world model 的训练目标从“服务某个任务”改成“覆盖 embodiment 的物理先验”，这和基座模型预训练里追求 transferable prior 的思路是一致的。第二，它把 reward 从任务内监督中解耦出来，改用冻结 VLM 做 zero-shot success judgment，这相当于把通用视觉语义能力接到了 RL 后训练接口上。第三，它说明在 VLA 场景里，预训练和后训练的边界可以重新划分：world model 与 reward 准备一次，后续只适配 policy。这个范式如果成立，影响的是数据预算结构，而不只是单点指标提升。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model。作者基于 WAN 2.1 搭建动作条件视频生成器，但训练数据严格来自 broad-coverage、与下游任务无关的交互数据，例如 play data 或 benchmark 中不含目标任务的任务集合。关键点不是模型结构新，而是训练约束新：world model 不允许看 target-task rollout，因此它必须靠更广覆盖的行为分布去学可迁移的物理动力学，而不是记住任务模板。

第二块是 zero-shot reward。作者不训练任务专用 reward model，而是把 imagined rollout 视频和文本指令交给冻结的 Qwen3-VL，由其直接判断任务是否成功，输出二值奖励。这样 reward source 也不再依赖目标任务标注器。这里的取舍很清楚：牺牲一部分 reward 精细度，换取跨任务可复用性和零额外标注。

第三块是在 world model 内做 policy optimization。策略采用 OpenVLA-OFT，先用极少量 demonstration 做 SFT，把策略锚定到新任务语义；然后在冻结 world model 中用 GRPO 做 RL。由于 imagined rollout 在未见任务上更容易出现 hallucinated success，作者加了 dual-noise verification：对同一初始条件，用不同 diffusion noise 生成多条 rollout，只有当 VLM reward 在不同噪声下保持一致时，才把该奖励视为可信。这一步不是简单 ensemble，而是专门针对生成式 world model 的 reward hacking 问题：如果成功只在某个噪声样本里出现，往往说明是模型幻觉而非稳定可实现的轨迹。

从方法定位看，RAW-Dream 的创新不在单个组件，而在组合方式和约束设计。它没有重新发明 VLA、VLM 或 video diffusion WM，而是把三者放进一个严格 task-agnostic 的后训练闭环里，并补上了 hallucination-aware reward verification 这个必要环节。
summary.experiments:
实验分成仿真和真实机器人两部分。仿真上，作者在 LIBERO 上训练 world model 时只使用 LIBERO-90 数据，并把 Spatial、Object、Goal、Long 四个 held-out task suites 作为 world-model 训练时完全未见的下游任务。这个设定比常见的 imagined RL 更严格，因为不是同任务低样本，而是 world model 对目标任务零暴露。结果上，RAW-Dream 相比 1-shot SFT baseline 带来 +8.9% 的提升，并且优于需要 50× 更多真实世界数据的 online RL。这个对比很关键，它说明 task-agnostic WM + zero-shot reward 并不是只在“省数据但性能差一些”的角落里成立，而是在数据效率上有明显优势。

真实机器人上，world model 只用多样、未清洗的 play data 预训练，不看目标任务数据。每个新任务从 3-shot SFT 起步，再进入 imagined RL。最终成功率相对 3-shot SFT baseline 有 +21.7% 的绝对提升。对机器人场景来说，这个幅度已经足以说明 dream-based RL 不是纯粹的模拟器内自娱自乐，而是能把少量 demonstration 放大成可观的真实收益。

从文中叙述看，值得注意的消融主要有三类：一是验证 task-agnostic WM 相比 target-task-specific 方案在 unseen-task setting 下的适配能力；二是验证 VLM zero-shot reward 的可用性；三是 dual-noise verification 对抑制 hallucinated success 和 false-positive reward hacking 的作用。虽然给出的摘要片段没有完整表格数字，但论文主结论依赖的不是单一主表，而是这三类消融共同支撑：world model 要足够通用，reward 要足够稳，RL 才能在未见任务上真正工作。
summary.reading_guide:
精读时先抓三处。第一是 Introduction 里对问题设定的限定：不是一般的 world-model RL，而是“target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in WMs”。这句话决定了整篇工作的评价标准。第二是 Method 里 world model、zero-shot VLM reward、GRPO、dual-noise verification 之间的接口设计，尤其要看 reward 是如何从 imagined video 中提取、如何做一致性过滤，以及 policy 更新时哪些模块冻结、哪些模块可训练。第三是实验部分关于 LIBERO held-out suites 和 real-robot play-data 预训练的设定，这些设定决定了结果是否真的说明了 transferable physical prior，而不是数据泄漏。

如果时间有限，优先看：任务设定图、整体 pipeline 图、LIBERO 主结果表、dual-noise verification 消融、真实机器人结果。若要深挖，建议重点想两个问题：一，task-agnostic world model 的能力边界到底由数据覆盖决定，还是由生成模型 fidelity 决定；二，VLM reward 在 imagined video 上的误判会不会形成系统性偏差，dual-noise 只是降噪还是已经足够构成可靠的 reward filter。阅读时间大约 45–70 分钟，若连附录中的实现细节和失败案例一起看，可能需要更久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific bottleneck in world-model-based VLA post-training: how to improve a policy on new tasks when the world model has never seen target-task rollouts and the reward source is also task-agnostic. Prior imagined-RL pipelines reduce real-world interaction cost, but they still depend on target-task data to train or adapt the world model, and often require task-specific reward classifiers or reference trajectories. That makes them hard to scale to unseen tasks. RAW-Dream reframes the setup: pretrain a reusable action-conditioned world model on broad interaction data, use a frozen VLM as a zero-shot reward judge over imagined videos plus instructions, and adapt only the policy with a small amount of demonstrations followed by RL inside the frozen simulator.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new backbone but a cleaner decomposition of what should be pretrained once versus adapted per task. The world model is treated as a reusable physical prior rather than a task-bound simulator, and the reward is outsourced to a general VLM instead of a task-specific learned head. For pretraining-oriented readers, this matters because it shifts the scaling question from 'how much target-task data do I need to build a simulator' to 'how broad and transferable can my embodiment-level physical prior become.' It also gives a concrete pretrain-to-posttrain interface: prepare a task-agnostic simulator and reward mechanism once, then spend downstream data only on policy anchoring. That is a meaningful change in data allocation, not just a small algorithmic tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three core pieces. First, a task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model. The implementation is built on WAN 2.1, but the important design choice is the training constraint: the world model is trained only on broad, target-task-independent interaction data such as play data or non-overlapping benchmark tasks. The goal is to learn transferable physical dynamics rather than task templates.

Second, zero-shot reward from a frozen VLM. Instead of training a reward model for each task, the method feeds imagined rollout videos and the language instruction into Qwen3-VL and asks for binary success judgments. This removes the need for task-specific reward supervision. The trade-off is clear: less reward shaping and less task specialization, in exchange for much better reuse across tasks.

Third, policy optimization inside the frozen world model. The policy backbone is OpenVLA-OFT. It is first lightly supervised with a few demonstrations to bind the policy to the new task semantics, then optimized with GRPO entirely in imagination. Because unseen-task rollouts from a generative world model can produce hallucinated successes, the paper adds a dual-noise verification mechanism: generate rollouts under different diffusion noise seeds from the same initial condition, and accept the reward only when the VLM judgment is consistent across them. This is a targeted defense against reward hacking induced by world-model hallucination. A success that appears only under one noise realization is treated as unreliable.

The novelty is therefore mostly in the system design and the constraints, not in inventing a new VLA, VLM, or video diffusion model. RAW-Dream turns existing components into a strictly task-agnostic post-training loop and adds the minimum extra machinery needed to make that loop stable on unseen tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers both simulation and real robots. In simulation, the world model is trained only on LIBERO-90 data, while four held-out suites—Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long—are used as downstream tasks that are completely unseen during world-model training. This is a stronger test than the usual low-data adaptation setting because the simulator has zero exposure to the target tasks. RAW-Dream improves over a 1-shot SFT baseline by +8.9% and outperforms online RL despite the latter using 50x more real-world data. That comparison is important: the method is not merely data-efficient at the cost of weak performance; it is competitive in a regime where real interaction is expensive.

On real robots, the world model is pretrained only on diverse, uncurated play data, again without target-task rollouts. Each new task starts from a 3-shot SFT policy and is then refined through imagined RL. The reported gain is +21.7% absolute success rate over the 3-shot SFT baseline. For robotic manipulation, that is a large enough margin to show that the imagined training signal is doing real work rather than producing simulator-only improvements.

The most important ablations appear to be: whether a task-agnostic world model can support unseen-task adaptation at all, whether zero-shot VLM reward is reliable enough to drive RL, and whether dual-noise verification reduces hallucinated success and false-positive reward hacking. Even without every table reproduced here, the paper’s empirical case depends on this combination rather than on a single headline number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem definition in the introduction. The phrase to keep in mind is 'target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in world models.' That is the real claim. Then read the method section with attention to the interfaces: how the imagined video is produced, how Qwen3-VL is prompted to score success, what is frozen versus trainable, and how GRPO consumes the filtered rewards. The dual-noise verification mechanism deserves close reading because it addresses a failure mode that is easy to miss if one only looks at average success rates.

In the experiments, focus on the exact train-test split for LIBERO and the real-robot setup using only play data for world-model pretraining. Those details determine whether the results truly demonstrate transferable physical priors or just hidden task overlap. If time is limited, read the pipeline figure, the main LIBERO table, the ablation on reward verification, and the real-robot results. If reading deeply, ask two questions: is the main bottleneck coverage of interaction data or fidelity of the generative world model, and is VLM-based reward merely noisy or systematically biased on imagined videos. Expect roughly 45–70 minutes for a careful pass, longer if you also inspect appendices and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表；若结果扎实，它会改变 VLA 后训练里“每任务重训 world/reward”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and main tables; if the results hold, it weakens the default of retraining world and reward models per VLA task.

paper.title: Block-R1: Rethinking the Role of Block Size in Multi-domain Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recently, reinforcement learning (RL) has been widely applied during post-training for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) to enhance reasoning with block-wise semi-autoregressive generation. Block size has therefore become a vital factor in dLLMs, since it determines the parallel decoding granularity and affects the rollout trajectories during RL optimisation, e.g., GRPO. Instead of investigating the effect of block size during inference on individual domains, this paper studies block size

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散大语言模型（dLLM）多域RL后训练中固定块大小导致的域冲突问题，即不同任务域的最优生成块大小存在异质性，统一块大小会显著降低多域训练的整体效果。
summary.importance: 补充了扩散LLM半自回归生成范式下RL后训练的设计维度，为多域训练的块大小适配提供了可落地的参考方案和标准化基准。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化定义dLLM多域RL中的域块大小冲突，证明固定统一块大小会天然限制异构域的全局优化能力。随后提出Block-R1基准，通过师生评估pipeline为每个训练样本标注最优训练块大小，基于样本级块大小标注实现块条件的策略更新，从数据层面缓解域冲突。
summary.experiments: 构建了包含13个数据集、41K样本的Block-R1-41K数据集，覆盖7种最新RL算法和多种dLLM骨干。实验显示，相比固定块大小的多域RL训练，样本级块条件训练方法在各域的平均性能提升超过12%，同时避免了单域性能退化的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分的域冲突现象观察、数据集构造的核心流程，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Address the domain conflict caused by fixed block size in multi-domain reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of diffusion large language models (dLLMs), i.e., different task domains have heterogeneous optimal generation block sizes, and unified block size significantly degrades the overall performance of multi-domain training.
summary_en.importance: It supplements the design dimension of RL post-training under the semi-autoregressive generation paradigm of dLLMs, and provides an implementable reference scheme and standardized benchmark for block size adaptation in multi-domain training.
summary_en.technical_approach: First formalize the domain block size conflict in multi-domain RL for dLLMs, and prove that fixed unified block size inherently limits the global optimization capacity across heterogeneous domains. Then propose Block-R1 benchmark: annotate the optimal training block size for each sample via a teacher-student evaluation pipeline, and implement block-conditioned policy update based on sample-level block size annotations to mitigate domain conflict from the data level.
summary_en.experiments: The Block-R1-41K dataset with 41K samples across 13 datasets is constructed, covering 7 latest RL algorithms and multiple dLLM backbones. Experiments show that compared with multi-domain RL training with fixed block size, the sample-level block-conditioned training method achieves over 12% average performance improvement across domains, and avoids the problem of single-domain performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the domain conflict observation in introduction and the core process of dataset construction, estimated reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: dLLM 的 block size 不只是解码超参；先看 conflict score 和分领域曲线，值得在内部 RL ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Block size is not just a decoding knob for dLLMs; inspect the conflict score and per-domain curves, then reproduce the ablation internally.

paper.title: How to Compress KV Cache in RL Post-Training? Shadow Mask Distillation for Memory-Efficient Alignment
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for unlocking the advanced reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), encompassing frameworks like RLHF and RLAIF. Regardless of the specific optimization algorithm (e.g., PPO, GRPO, or Online DPO), online RL inherently requires an exploratory trajectory generation (rollout) phase. However, for long-context reasoning tasks, this rollout phase imposes a severe ``memory wall'' due to the exorbitant Key-Value (KV) cache foot

summary.core_problem: RL后训练（如RLHF、GRPO、Online DPO）的rollout阶段生成长上下文轨迹时，KV缓存占用过高形成内存墙，直接使用KV缓存压缩会导致生成阶段的稀疏上下文策略与优化阶段的稠密上下文策略不一致，产生严重的离策略偏差，引发梯度更新错误甚至策略崩溃；现有基于拒绝采样、重要性加权的统计修正方法存在样本效率低、梯度方差大的问题，同时KV物理驱逐会引发内存碎片化峰值导致OOM。
summary.importance: 首次从架构层面而非统计修正层面解决RL后训练中KV压缩带来的离策略偏差问题，消除了长上下文RL对齐的内存瓶颈，同时保留训练稳定性，为长序列场景的RLHF规模化落地提供了可行的工程方案；对预训练-后训练闭环中的长上下文能力落地有直接的工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Shadow Mask Distillation（SMD）双轨框架：1. rollout阶段使用KV压缩生成轨迹的同时，记录对应上下文保留位置的二进制“影子掩码”；2. 优化阶段将影子掩码直接注入学习者的因果注意力矩阵，使学习者与生成阶段的策略严格对齐，完全消除离策略方差；3. 并行执行一次稠密上下文前向传播，通过KL散度损失将全局上下文推理能力蒸馏到掩码策略中，避免模型过拟合截断上下文；4. 原生实现避免了物理KV驱逐带来的内存分配峰值，无需底层C++/CUDA修改，框架无关。
summary.experiments: 在Reddit TL;DR摘要基准上测试：SMD的ROUGE-L指标相比稠密基线相对提升0.6%，在收敛速度和训练稳定性上显著优于统计加权基线；同时完全消除了优化阶段的瞬时内存碎片化峰值，在相同硬件下可支持更大的批量大小和更长的上下文输入。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读方法论部分的双轨机制设计和工程实现细节，重点关注图1的整体框架示意和内存峰值问题的分析部分；泛读实验部分的基准对比结果，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: During the rollout phase of RL post-training (e.g., RLHF, GRPO, Online DPO) for long-context trajectory generation, excessive KV cache footprint creates a memory wall. Direct application of KV cache compression leads to inconsistency between the sparse-context policy during generation and the dense-context policy during optimization, causing severe off-policy bias, erroneous gradient updates, and even policy collapse. Existing statistical correction methods based on rejection sampling and importance weighting suffer from low sample efficiency and high gradient variance, while physical KV eviction triggers memory fragmentation spikes leading to OOM errors.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the off-policy bias caused by KV compression in RL post-training from an architectural rather than statistical perspective for the first time. It eliminates the memory bottleneck of long-context RL alignment while preserving training stability, providing a feasible engineering solution for large-scale deployment of RLHF in long-sequence scenarios. It has direct engineering reference value for the implementation of long-context capabilities in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Shadow Mask Distillation (SMD) dual-track framework is proposed: 1. During the rollout phase, KV compression is applied to generate trajectories while a binary "shadow mask" recording the positions of retained context is recorded. 2. During the optimization phase, the shadow mask is directly injected into the learner's causal attention matrix to strictly align the learner with the generation policy, completely eliminating off-policy variance. 3. A dense-context forward pass is executed in parallel, and global context reasoning capability is distilled into the masked policy via KL divergence loss to prevent the model from overfitting to truncated context. 4. The native implementation avoids memory allocation spikes caused by physical KV eviction, requires no low-level C++/CUDA modifications, and is framework-agnostic.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on the Reddit TL;DR summarization benchmark: SMD achieves a 0.6% relative improvement in ROUGE-L over the dense baseline, and significantly outperforms statistical weighting baselines in convergence speed and training stability. It also completely eliminates instantaneous memory fragmentation spikes during the optimization phase, supporting larger batch sizes and longer context inputs on the same hardware.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the dual-track mechanism design and engineering implementation details in the methodology section, paying special attention to Figure 1 illustrating the overall framework and the analysis of memory spike issues. Skim the benchmark comparison results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation；若 off-policy bias 证据干净，内部长链 RL rollout 的 KV 压缩策略要重新测。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the off-policy-bias evidence is clean, long-chain RL rollout KV compression needs retesting internally.

paper.title: Implicit Compression Regularization: Concise Reasoning via Internal Shorter Distributions in RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves LLM reasoning but often induces overthinking, where models generate unnecessarily long reasoning traces. Existing methods mainly rely on length penalties or early-exit strategies; however, the former may degrade accuracy and induce underthinking, whereas the latter assumes that substantial portions of reasoning traces can be safely truncated. To obtain a compression signal without these limitations, we revisit the training dynamics of exist

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RL reasoning post-training 里的一个具体但很棘手的问题：模型在 outcome reward 驱动下会学会写越来越长的推理链，其中相当一部分是冗余反思、重复验证和无效展开。已有做法通常直接对长度加惩罚，或者在推理时做 early exit / truncation，但前者会把“更短”变成显式优化目标，容易把策略推向 underthinking；后者则默认后半段推理大多可裁剪，这在高难题上并不稳。文章想解决的是：能不能不显式奖励短答案，也不截断推理，而是从 on-policy rollout 里提取一个更安全的压缩信号，让模型朝“已经被自己证明可行的更短正确轨迹”靠拢。
summary.importance: 启发点不在于提出了一个全新的 RL 算法，而在于它把“过度推理”重新表述成训练分布内部的长度—正确率相关性问题。文中观察到，压缩训练早期，组内更短的样本反而更可能是正确的；随着长度惩罚继续推进，这个相关性会从负转正，说明策略已经从去冗余滑向了欠思考。这个视角很有价值，因为它把长度控制从 reward shaping 问题，转成了 rollout distribution 里是否存在“安全压缩目标”的问题。对做 reasoning RL、test-time compute 控制、以及 post-train 反哺 pretrain 的人来说，这个 framing 比单纯再调一个 length penalty 更有研究价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Implicit Compression Regularization, ICR。核心做法是：在每个 rollout group 内，不再直接给短答案额外奖励，而是先找出“正确样本里最短的那些轨迹”，把它们视为当前策略已经发现的 concise-but-correct target，然后用这些样本诱导一个 virtual shorter distribution，对当前策略做正则。这样做的关键区别是，压缩信号来自策略自己在 on-policy 采样中已经找到的正确短轨迹，而不是人工规定“越短越好”。

文章先系统分析了 length penalty 的训练动态。通过调不同长度系数 λ，作者发现更强的 penalty 的确能更快缩短输出，但也更快损伤训练准确率，并且会恶化 accuracy-length Pareto frontier。更重要的是，他们定义并跟踪 group-wise length-accuracy correlation：在同一个问题的一组 rollout 中，长度和正确性之间的相关系数如果为负，表示短答案更可能正确，属于 overthinking regime；如果为正，则说明继续压缩会更容易伤到正确性，进入 underthinking regime。ICR 就是利用这个负相关阶段，从组内最短正确样本中抽取监督信号。

从机制上看，ICR不是在 reward 上做硬编码，而更像一种 policy regularization：它鼓励策略把概率质量向“已经验证过的短正确模式”转移。这样可以避免长度惩罚常见的 shortcut——模型学会少写，而不是学会更紧凑地思考。文中还强调 ICR 与 mild length penalty 兼容：如果目标是更强压缩，可以在 ICR 之上叠加较弱的长度项，由 ICR 负责守住正确性边界。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验覆盖了三个 reasoning backbone，以及数学和知识密集型的多个 benchmark。论文主结论是：ICR 能在持续缩短 response length 的同时保持甚至提升准确率，并且得到更好的 accuracy-length Pareto frontier。作者还展示了训练过程中的动态曲线：相比纯 length penalty，ICR 能更长时间维持更健康的 length-accuracy correlation，也就是“短且对”的样本不会那么快消失。

摘要里给出的结果是定性的强结论，没有在已提供内容中看到完整表格数字、各 backbone 参数规模、训练 token 数、rollout group size、以及具体 benchmark 上的逐项提升幅度，因此不能捏造具体数值。可以确认的实验重点包括：1）不同 λ 下 length penalty 的动态对比；2）ICR 与显式长度惩罚、truncation 类方法的 Pareto 对比；3）多 backbone 泛化；4）与 mild length penalty 结合时的进一步压缩效果；5）用 correlation 轨迹解释何时开始进入 underthinking。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着“训练动态分析”去读，而不是只看最终分数。

建议先看 Introduction 里对 length–accuracy correlation 的动机描述，再看 Method 开头关于不同 λ 的现象分析。这里是全文最有信息量的部分，因为它解释了为什么显式长度奖励常常把问题做坏：不是压缩本身有害，而是“直接优化短”太容易被策略利用。

然后重点看 ICR 如何构造 shortest correct samples 和 virtual shorter distribution。需要弄清三个问题：第一，correct sample 的判定是否完全依赖 verifiable reward；第二，组内最短正确样本是单个还是一个子集；第三，这个 regularization 是作用在 token level、sequence level，还是 policy ratio 上。若要快速泛读，优先看方法图、训练动态曲线、accuracy-length Pareto 图，预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主线。若要深挖，值得进一步检查它对 hard questions 的行为：当组内根本没有短正确样本时，ICR 退化成什么；以及它是否会偏向模板化短解，损伤探索多样性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in RL-based reasoning post-training: outcome-level rewards often push models toward unnecessarily long chains of thought, with redundant reflection, repeated checking, and wasted test-time compute. Existing fixes mostly use explicit length penalties or early-exit/truncation. The first turns brevity into a direct optimization target and can induce underthinking; the second assumes later reasoning steps are largely disposable, which is unsafe on harder problems. The paper asks whether compression can be learned from on-policy rollouts themselves, without rewarding shortness directly and without truncating trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the framing. Instead of treating overthinking as a reward-design issue, the paper characterizes it through the correlation between response length and correctness within rollout groups. Early in compression, shorter samples are often more likely to be correct; later, that relation flips as the policy drifts into underthinking. This is a useful lens for reasoning RL because it separates safe redundancy removal from harmful compression. For researchers working on RLVR, test-time compute control, or the interface between post-training and pretraining, this is more informative than another variant of length shaping.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Implicit Compression Regularization (ICR), extracts compression targets from the model’s own successful rollouts. Instead of adding a handcrafted reward for shorter outputs, it identifies the shortest correct responses within each rollout group and uses them to induce a virtual shorter distribution. The current policy is then regularized toward these concise-but-correct trajectories.

The paper first analyzes the dynamics of explicit length penalties under different coefficients. Stronger penalties reduce length faster, but they also degrade accuracy earlier and worsen the accuracy-length Pareto frontier. More importantly, the group-wise length-correctness correlation starts negative and gradually increases during training. A negative correlation means shorter responses are, on average, more likely to be correct within the current rollout distribution; a positive correlation indicates compression is now cutting into necessary reasoning. ICR is designed to exploit the former regime.

Mechanistically, this is closer to policy regularization than reward shaping. The compression signal is not “be shorter”; it is “move probability mass toward shorter trajectories that are already verified as correct under the current policy.” That distinction matters. It reduces the shortcut where the model simply writes less rather than reasoning more compactly. The paper also argues that ICR is compatible with mild length penalties when stronger compression is needed, with ICR acting as a guardrail against underthinking.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experiments span three reasoning backbones and multiple math and knowledge-intensive benchmarks. The main empirical claim is consistent: ICR reduces response length while preserving or even improving accuracy, and yields a better accuracy-length Pareto frontier than explicit compression baselines. The training-dynamics plots are central: compared with pure length penalties, ICR maintains a healthier length-accuracy correlation for longer, meaning concise responses remain aligned with correctness instead of quickly drifting into underthinking.

The available text does not include the full result tables, exact model sizes, rollout group sizes, training budgets, or per-benchmark gains, so those numbers should not be fabricated. What is clearly supported is the experimental structure: (1) dynamic comparisons across different length coefficients; (2) Pareto comparisons between ICR and explicit length-penalty or truncation-style methods; (3) generalization across multiple backbones; (4) compatibility with mild length penalties for stronger compression; and (5) correlation trajectories as a diagnostic for the onset of underthinking.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper as a training-dynamics paper first, and a compression method second.

Start with the introduction and the early method section where the authors analyze length penalties under different coefficients. That part explains the central claim: compression itself is not the problem; directly optimizing for shortness is. Then focus on how ICR constructs the shortest correct samples and the virtual shorter distribution. Three implementation details matter: how correctness is defined, whether the target set is a single shortest sample or a subset, and whether the regularization is applied at the token, sequence, or policy level.

For a quick pass, read the method figure, the length-accuracy correlation plots, and the Pareto frontier figures. That should be enough in about 30 minutes. For a deeper read, inspect failure cases: what happens when a rollout group contains no short correct sample, and whether the method risks collapsing exploration into overly templated short solutions.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练中长度-准确率相关性的动态观察很有价值，§3的训练动态分析可直接用于内部RL训练的监控指标设计。
recommendation.en: The observation of length-accuracy correlation dynamics in RL post-training is valuable; the training dynamic analysis in §3 can be directly used for internal RL training monitoring metric design.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Not All Tokens Learn Alike: Attention Entropy Reveals Heterogeneous Signals in RL Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement-learning-based post-training has become a key approach for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but its token-level learning signals remain poorly understood. This work studies their heterogeneity through attention entropy, which measures how concentrated or diffuse the contextual support is for each response token.   We first show that token-level RL objectives are sparsely estimable: uniformly random 20 percent token subsets preserve much of the full-token he

summary.core_problem: RLVR/推理类 RL post-train 往往把一条长推理链上的所有 response tokens 当作“等价的学习信号”来平均更新，但实际每个 token 承载的 credit assignment 质量、稳定性和信息类型可能高度异质。论文要回答两个问题：token-level RL 目标是否可以被稀疏子集稳定估计；以及哪些“结构化子集”提供稳定/互补/高风险的学习信号，从而解释为什么一些训练看似正常却会早停、塌缩或卡在浅层推理。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的价值主要在“诊断与信号分解”：用一个纯前向可计算的指标（attention entropy）把 token 更新拆成稳定骨架（anchors）与高方差探索信号（explorers），从而更可解释地讨论 RL 训练动态、loss spike/塌缩风险、以及 token credit 的冗余度。结论之一是 token-level RL 目标在统计上“稀疏可估”（随机取 20% token 仍保留相当性能），这对降低 RL 训练成本、设计更稳的 token reweighting/采样策略有直接启发；但更关键的是：不同 token 子集并不等价，盲目稀疏化可能把训练推向“稳定但上限低”或“信息更强但不稳定”的极端。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是用 attention entropy 作为 token 级别的“上下文支撑集中度”诊断。对每个 response token y_t，在某一层把所有 head 的 attention 概率平均成分布 a_{t,j}^{(ℓ)}，计算归一化熵 H_t^{norm}（消除可见上下文长度带来的机械性熵增长）。在每个样本内部按熵排序，定义 bottom 20% 为 anchor tokens（低熵、注意力集中），top 20% 为 explorer tokens（高熵、注意力分散）。
方法论上分两条线：
1) 选择性训练（hard-masked selective training）：只对选中的 token 计算/回传 token-level RL 损失（DAPO 框架下的 token-level objective），对比 full-token、random-20%、anchor-only、explorer-only 的优化轨迹与泛化。
2) 验证性干预（soft reweighting intervention）：不做二值 mask，而是给所有有效 response tokens 分配连续权重 w_t（优势项归一化等细节在附录），用“熵感知”的方式动态调节 anchors/explorers 的贡献，作为对前述诊断结论的因果验证，而不是替代现有 RL 算法的重度改造。
论文还做了多组“反解释”控制：控制 token 位置（避免低熵只是因为靠近开头/结尾）、控制 next-token predictive entropy（避免低熵只是模型更确定）、并分析熵的训练动态与梯度几何（方向一致性/方差）来支撑“稳定 vs 高方差”的谱系观点。
summary.experiments:
主要受控实验设置：Qwen3-8B-Base + VeRL + DAPO，n=8 rollouts/prompt，DeepScaler + MATH level 3-5，严格 \boxed{} exact-match 评测；分析只看 response tokens。关键结果包括：
- 稀疏可估性：随机抽取 20% token 的训练在 held-out 上仍能保留 full-token 的相当一部分效果，说明 token 更新存在显著冗余（论文强调这是统计可估性而非“随便丢 token 都行”）。
- 结构化子集差异：anchor-only 训练更稳定、梯度更对齐，通常不塌缩但在更难任务上更易平台；explorer-only 往往训练塌缩，但在未塌缩的轨迹里能看到更强的“硬推理”增益信号，说明其信息量更大但方差/不稳定性更高。
- 干预验证：在 full-data 的 soft reweighting 家族里，熵感知加权在最强的 entropy-source 设置下，把 Qwen3-8B-Base 的 held-out 平均分从 full-token DAPO 的 34.39 提升到 37.40（严格 exact-match）。同时报告浅层/中层/深层作为 entropy source 都能超过 full-token DAPO，但不同层的 profile 不同，说明效果不是绑死在单层（文中默认 mid-layer，如 Layer 20）。
（注：选择性训练与 soft reweighting 属于两套“匹配家族”，论文强调绝对分数只在家族内比较。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“optimization spectrum（anchor vs explorer）”的定义与主张，明确它不是在做新 RL 算法，而是在拆解 token 信号。
- 重点看 Preliminaries/Training Setup：attention entropy 的定义、归一化方式、within-sample 分位数划分（避免跨样本长度/难度混淆）、以及 hard mask vs soft weight 的实验分组逻辑。
- 结果部分优先看：随机 20% 的稀疏可估性结论；anchor-only/explorer-only 的训练曲线与塌缩现象；以及 soft reweighting 的主表（34.39→37.40）和 entropy-source layer 的对照。
- 如果时间够，再看控制实验与梯度几何分析：它们决定了“低熵=稳定骨架、高熵=高方差信号”是否只是位置/不确定性等伪相关。

summary_en.core_problem: Token-level learning signals in RL-for-reasoning (RLVR) are typically treated as exchangeable: a single outcome reward is spread over a long chain-of-thought, and all response tokens are averaged in the objective. This paper asks whether the token-level RL objective is statistically estimable from sparse token subsets, and—more importantly—whether structured subsets carry qualitatively different (stable vs volatile, easy vs hard) optimization signals that explain plateaus and collapses in RL post-training.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is diagnostic rather than proposing a new RL algorithm: attention entropy (a forward-pass metric) is used to decompose RL token updates into a stable backbone (low-entropy “anchors”) and high-variance but potentially complementary signals (high-entropy “explorers”). Two practical implications follow: (i) token-level RL objectives exhibit substantial redundancy (random 20% tokens retain a large fraction of performance), suggesting room for cheaper RL updates; (ii) sparsification is not neutral—different token subsets induce very different training dynamics, which matters for stability engineering and for designing token reweighting/selection rules at the pretrain↔post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach:
For each response token y_t, the method computes an attention distribution at a chosen layer by averaging attention probabilities across heads, then derives a normalized attention entropy H_t^{norm} to remove the trivial dependence on visible context length. Tokens are ranked within each sample (to avoid cross-sample length/difficulty confounds): bottom 20% are “anchors” (concentrated contextual support), top 20% are “explorers” (diffuse support).
Two experiment families are used:
1) Hard-masked selective training: only selected response tokens contribute to the token-level DAPO objective, comparing full-token vs random-20% vs anchor-only vs explorer-only.
2) Soft reweighting intervention: all valid response tokens remain in the objective, but are assigned nonnegative weights w_t (advantage-normalized), with entropy-aware weighting serving as a causal validation of the diagnostic.
The paper further runs controls to rule out alternative explanations (token position, next-token predictive entropy) and analyzes entropy dynamics plus gradient geometry to support the “stable vs volatile” spectrum interpretation.
summary_en.experiments:
Controlled setup centers on Qwen3-8B-Base trained with VeRL under DAPO, using 8 rollouts per prompt on DeepScaler + MATH level 3–5, evaluated by strict boxed exact match; analysis focuses on response tokens.
Key findings:
- Sparse estimability: random 20% token subsets preserve a substantial fraction of full-token held-out performance, indicating redundancy in token-level RL updates.
- Structured subsets are not interchangeable: anchor-only training is typically stable and well-aligned but tends to plateau on harder reasoning; explorer-only training often collapses, yet non-collapsed runs suggest explorers contain stronger hard-reasoning signal with higher directional volatility.
- Intervention result: entropy-aware soft reweighting improves the held-out average from 34.39 (full-token DAPO baseline in the matched family) to 37.40 on Qwen3-8B-Base under the strongest entropy-source setting. Using shallow/mid/deep layers as entropy sources all beats full-token DAPO, with different benchmark profiles, suggesting the effect is not tied to a single layer choice.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the “optimization spectrum” claim and what the paper is (diagnosis + validation) vs not (a replacement RL algorithm).
- In the setup section, focus on: normalized attention entropy definition, within-sample percentile partitioning, and the separation between hard-masked selective training and soft reweighting (scores are only comparable within each family).
- In results, prioritize: the random-20% sparsity result, anchor-only vs explorer-only training dynamics (including collapse/plateau behavior), and the main soft-reweighting table (34.39→37.40) plus entropy-source-layer comparisons.

paper.abstract: Existing robot video world models are typically trained with low-level objectives such as reconstruction and perceptual similarity, which are poorly aligned with the capabilities that matter most for robot decision making, including instruction following, manipulation success, and physical plausibility. They also suffer from error accumulation in long-horizon autoregressive prediction. We present RoboAlign-R1, a framework that combines reward-aligned post-training with stabilized long-horizon in

summary.core_problem: 现有机器人视频世界模型多采用重建、感知相似度等低层目标训练，与机器人决策所需的指令遵循、操作成功、物理合理性等高阶能力不匹配，同时自回归预测在长时序场景下存在误差累积问题。
summary.importance: 将大模型领域的奖励对齐范式迁移到机器人世界模型训练中，打通了多模态奖励蒸馏、对齐训练、推理稳定性优化的完整链路，对通用具身智能的统一预训练、多模态对齐方法有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RoboAlign-R1框架，分为两部分：1）奖励对齐训练：构建包含1万条标注视频-指令对的RobotWorldBench基准，训练8B参数的多模态教师判分模型RoboAlign-Judge提供6维细粒度生成视频评估，再蒸馏为98M参数的轻量学生奖励模型，支撑高效RL后训练，替代原有低层损失目标；2）长时序推理稳定性优化：提出无需训练的滑动窗口重编码（SWR）策略，在生成过程中定期刷新自回归上下文，缓解误差累积。
summary.experiments: 相比最优基线，域内评估综合性能提升10.1%，在线奖励计算开销降低10倍以上，结果同时通过VLM评估和盲测人类研究验证。滑动窗口重编码仅引入1%的额外延迟，带来SSIM提升2.8%、PSNR提升0.62dB、LPIPS降低9.8%，感兴趣区域LPIPS降低12.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3节方法细节、第4节实验结果，重点关注图1的框架架构、表2的消融实验结果、附录的奖励蒸馏实现细节。值得深挖的点包括多模态奖励蒸馏的成本-精度tradeoff、滑动窗口重编码策略对通用自回归长序列生成的可迁移性、具身模型对齐与LLM对齐范式的共性差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing robot video world models are mostly trained with low-level objectives like reconstruction and perceptual similarity, which mismatch high-level capabilities required for robot decision making including instruction following, manipulation success and physical plausibility. Autoregressive prediction also suffers from error accumulation in long-horizon scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It migrates the reward alignment paradigm from LLM domain to robot world model training, completing the full pipeline of multimodal reward distillation, alignment training and inference stability optimization. It provides direct reference for unified pre-training of general embodied intelligence and multimodal alignment methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The RoboAlign-R1 framework includes two modules: 1) Reward-aligned training: Construct RobotWorldBench, a benchmark with 10K annotated video-instruction pairs, train an 8B-parameter multimodal teacher judge RoboAlign-Judge to provide 6-dimensional fine-grained evaluation of generated videos, then distill it into a 98M-parameter lightweight student reward model to support efficient RL post-training, replacing original low-level loss objectives. 2) Long-horizon inference stability optimization: Propose a training-free sliding window re-encoding (SWR) strategy, which periodically refreshes autoregressive context during generation to mitigate error accumulation.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with the strongest baseline, aggregate in-domain evaluation performance improves by 10.1%, online reward computation overhead reduces by over 10x, results are validated by both VLM-based evaluation and blinded human studies. SWR introduces only 1% extra latency, bringing 2.8% higher SSIM, 0.62dB higher PSNR, 9.8% lower LPIPS, and 12.2% lower ROI-LPIPS.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read Section 3 (method details) and Section 4 (experimental results). Focus on the framework architecture in Figure 1, ablation study results in Table 2, and reward distillation implementation details in the appendix. Worth further exploring points include the cost-accuracy tradeoff of multimodal reward distillation, transferability of SWR strategy to general autoregressive long-sequence generation, and similarities and differences between embodied model alignment and LLM alignment paradigms.

paper.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Action via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning for VLA Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have increasingly incorporated reasoning mechanisms for complex robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches share a critical limitation: whether employing explicit linguistic reasoning that suffers from latency and discretization, or utilizing more expressive continuous latent reasoning, they are predominantly confined to static imitation learning that limits adaptability and generalization. While online reinforcement learning (RL) has been introduced t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 VLA 中一个很具体但重要的缺口：已有带 reasoning 的机器人策略，要么依赖显式语言推理，延迟高且难表达连续物理过程；要么做 latent reasoning，但训练方式仍主要是 imitation learning，缺少在线交互带来的适应性。与此同时，已有 VLA 的 RL post-training 又大多只优化 action space，没有把“先形成物理推理，再执行动作”这一内部过程纳入优化目标。作者的问题设定因此很明确：能否让 RL 直接作用于 latent physical reasoning 与 action generation 的耦合过程，而不是只在动作层面做 policy improvement。
summary.importance: 它对纯 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，因为主要是机器人 VLA post-training；但对“latent reasoning 是否能被训练信号显式塑形”这个更一般的问题有启发。尤其是两点。第一，作者把 latent CoT 当作隐式决策变量，而不是中间副产物，这和近来语言模型里对 latent reasoning、hidden scratchpad、continuous thought 的兴趣是同一方向。第二，LAPO 的核心思想是把环境奖励通过联合 likelihood ratio 传回 reasoning token 与 action token，这提供了一种 credit assignment 视角：如果中间推理不可见，仍然可以通过策略梯度间接塑造它。对研究 RL-pretrain、reasoning token、或 post-train 反哺内部表征的人，这个思路值得记一下。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 LaST-R1 架构。模型以预训练 Qwen3-VL-4B 为初始化，在机器人数据上继续预训练。执行时先自回归地产生 latent reasoning tokens，再以这些 latent token 为条件并行解码动作。这里 latent token 不是语言解释，而是连续或离散化后的内部推理表征，用来编码物理动态、未来状态和操作意图。作者还用 vision foundation model 的 global future representations 去 anchor 这些 latent token，目的是给 latent reasoning 一个稳定的语义/空间先验，避免它在训练中退化成无意义隐变量。第二部分是 LAPO。与只对动作概率做 PPO 式优化不同，LAPO 把 latent reasoning 和 action generation 放进统一的 step-level likelihood ratio 中，让环境奖励同时影响两者。直观上，策略不只是学“哪个动作回报高”，还学“哪种内部物理表征更有助于产生高回报动作”。这解决的是 credit assignment：奖励来自环境终局，但更新要能传到中间 reasoning。第三部分是 adaptive latent CoT。作者不固定 reasoning horizon，而是让模型根据任务复杂度动态调整 latent reasoning 长度。复杂任务多想几步，反应型任务少想甚至近似跳过，以平衡性能和时延。训练流程上，先做大规模机器人预训练，再对具体任务做 SFT warm-up，最后进入在线 RL post-training。
summary.experiments: 从引言可确认的关键结果包括：模型以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为底座，在多个机器人操作数据集上预训练；在 LIBERO benchmark 上，one-shot warm-up 后平均成功率达到 99.8%，高于已有基线；在四个真实世界复杂任务上，LAPO 相比 warm-up 初始策略最高带来 44% 提升，单臂和双臂场景平均成功率达到 90%；RL 后训练后还能对未见物体、背景、光照实现 zero-shot generalization。实验主线大致有三类。第一，和 vanilla action-only RL policy 比较，证明联合优化 latent reasoning + action 比只优化动作更稳、更能泛化。第二，验证 adaptive latent CoT 的收益，说明固定推理长度不是最优折中。第三，真实机器人实验说明改进不只存在于仿真。由于给出的全文片段主要是引言，具体消融数字、训练步数、rollout 配置、奖励设计细节还需要看实验章节原文才能完整确认；但从问题设定和结果摘要看，作者想证明的核心命题已经很清楚：latent reasoning 不是只能靠 imitation 学，也可以被在线 RL 直接塑形。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 1 对比 action-only RL 与 reasoning-before-acting RL 的差异，这是整篇工作的主轴。然后重点读方法部分里 LaST-R1 的生成顺序：latent token 如何产生、如何条件化动作解码、future representation 如何做 anchor。接着读 LAPO 的目标函数，尤其是联合 likelihood ratio 怎么写、与 PPO 的差别在哪里、奖励如何分配到 reasoning token。若你关心语言模型里的 latent reasoning，这部分最值得细看。实验部分优先看三组对比：有无 latent reasoning、有无 LAPO、固定与自适应 reasoning horizon。真实机器人结果也建议看，因为它决定这类方法是不是只在仿真里成立。若时间有限，可以先跳过具体任务描述和视觉展示，保留算法公式、训练流程图、主表和关键消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in VLA training. Existing reasoning-enabled robot policies either rely on explicit language reasoning, which is slow and poorly matched to continuous physical dynamics, or use latent reasoning but still train mostly with imitation learning, limiting adaptation. Meanwhile, online RL for VLA usually optimizes only the action space and ignores the internal reasoning process. The central question here is whether RL can optimize the coupled process of latent physical reasoning and action generation, rather than improving actions alone.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to core LLM pretraining is modest, since this is primarily a robotics VLA post-training paper. Still, it is useful for a broader line of work around latent reasoning. Two aspects stand out. First, latent CoT is treated as an actual decision variable rather than an incidental hidden state. That connects naturally to current interest in hidden scratchpads, continuous thought, and latent reasoning in language models. Second, LAPO offers a concrete credit-assignment mechanism: even when intermediate reasoning is not externally supervised, environmental reward can still shape it through a joint policy objective over reasoning and action tokens. That idea is relevant to anyone thinking about RL-pretrain, internal reasoning representations, or how post-training can sculpt hidden computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three main components. First, the LaST-R1 architecture. It is initialized from Qwen3-VL-4B and further pretrained on large-scale robotic manipulation datasets. At inference time, the model autoregressively generates latent reasoning tokens before producing actions, and those latent tokens condition a parallel action decoder. These tokens are not natural-language explanations; they are internal reasoning representations intended to capture physical dynamics, future state structure, and manipulation intent. To stabilize them, the authors anchor the latent reasoning space to global future representations from a vision foundation model, providing semantic and spatial priors so the latent variables do not drift into arbitrary hidden codes. Second, LAPO, or Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization. Instead of applying PPO-style optimization only to action probabilities, LAPO defines a joint step-level likelihood ratio over latent reasoning and action generation. This allows environmental reward to influence both the internal reasoning trajectory and the final action policy. The key benefit is better credit assignment: the reward arrives from interaction outcomes, but the update can still reach the intermediate reasoning process. Third, the adaptive latent CoT mechanism. Rather than fixing a constant reasoning horizon, the model adjusts the amount of latent reasoning based on task demands. Harder tasks can allocate more internal computation, while reactive tasks can use shorter reasoning for lower latency. The overall training recipe is pretraining on robotic data, task-specific SFT warm-up, and then online RL post-training.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text excerpt, the main confirmed results are as follows: the model is built on Qwen3-VL-4B and pretrained on multiple robotic manipulation datasets; on LIBERO, it reaches a 99.8% average success rate with one-shot warm-up, outperforming prior baselines; on four real-world complex tasks, LAPO improves over the warm-up policy by up to 44%, reaching a 90% average success rate across single-arm and dual-arm settings; after RL post-training, the system also shows zero-shot generalization to unseen objects, backgrounds, and lighting conditions. The experimental story appears to have three pillars. First, comparisons against vanilla action-only RL policies show that jointly optimizing latent reasoning and actions improves robustness and generalization. Second, adaptive latent CoT is evaluated against fixed reasoning horizons, supporting the claim that reasoning depth should be task-dependent. Third, real-robot experiments indicate the gains are not confined to simulation. Since the provided text is mostly the introduction, exact ablation numbers, rollout settings, reward definitions, and training budgets still need to be checked in the full experimental section. Even so, the intended claim is already clear: latent reasoning does not have to be learned only through imitation; it can be directly shaped by online RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 40 minutes. Start with Figure 1, which contrasts action-only RL with reasoning-before-acting RL; that figure captures the paper’s main thesis. Then read the method section for the generation order in LaST-R1: how latent tokens are produced, how they condition action decoding, and how future representations are used as anchors. After that, focus on the LAPO objective, especially how the joint likelihood ratio is defined and how it differs from standard PPO. If your interest is latent reasoning in language models, this is the most transferable part. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: with versus without latent reasoning, with versus without LAPO, and fixed versus adaptive reasoning horizon. The real-world robot section is also worth reading because it tests whether the method survives outside simulation. If time is limited, skip detailed task descriptions and visual examples, and keep the algorithm equations, training pipeline figure, main result tables, and key ablations.

recommendation.zh: 多模态VLA模型RL后训练的创新方法，仅需读方法部分§3的LAPO算法设计即可
recommendation.en: Innovative RL post-training method for VLA models, only need to read §3 for LAPO algorithm design

paper.title: Why Does Reinforcement Learning Generalize? A Feature-Level Mechanistic Study of Post-Training in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training often improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) beyond the training domain, while supervised fine-tuning (SFT) frequently leads to general capabilities forgetting. However, the mechanisms underlying this contrast remain unclear. To bridge this gap, we present a feature-level mechanistic analysis methodology to probe RL generalization using a controlled experimental setup, where RL- and SFT-tuned models are trained from the

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个对 post-train 和 pretrain 接口都很关键的问题：为什么同样从基座模型出发、使用相同训练数据，RL 往往能带来跨任务泛化，而 SFT 更容易引入任务特化和能力遗忘。作者不只比较外部指标，而是把 base、SFT、RL 模型的内部激活对齐到同一个稀疏特征空间，观察训练范式如何改写表示。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析方法和 post-training 动态解释。它对预训练研究的价值不在于提出新的 optimizer 或 loss，而在于给出了一个可操作的表示层证据：RL 的 outcome-level 信号可能不是简单地拟合训练题，而是强化一小组可迁移的内部特征；SFT 则更快写入大量窄域特征。这对 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-train、annealing/cooldown 后接 RL、以及用 post-train 结果反推预训练数据和目标设计都有信息量。量级上，它更像是解释框架和诊断工具，而不是直接提升模型能力的训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计强调可比性。第一，base、SFT、RL 从同一个基座模型出发，并在相同数据上训练，使表示差异尽量归因于训练范式，而不是数据或初始化。第二，使用 Sparse Crosscoder 对齐不同模型的 residual-stream activation。Sparse Crosscoder 可以看作跨模型版本的 sparse autoencoder：把不同模型的激活编码到共享稀疏特征，再分别解码回各自模型的激活空间。这样可以比较某个特征在 base 和 tuned model 中是保留、增强、削弱，还是新出现。第三，提出三模型 Sparse Crosscoder，将 base、SFT、RL 放入同一个稀疏特征空间，而不是只做 base-SFT、base-RL 的两两比较。第四，引入 Model Attribution Score，用来度量某个特征更偏向哪个模型或训练范式。第五，专门分析 generalization cases：选择 RL 成功而 base 失败的样本，寻找激活差异显著的特征，再通过干预验证因果性。干预包括在 RL 模型中抑制这些特征，以及在 base 模型中放大这些特征。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文内容没有暴露具体模型参数量、训练 token 数、任务集合、准确率表格或干预幅度数字，因此不能补写具体数值。可确认的关键结果有四点。第一，SFT 很快产生大量高度特化的特征，并且这些特征在训练早期就趋于稳定。第二，RL 的特征变化更克制，且在训练中持续演化，同时更大程度保留 base model 的表示结构。第三，在 RL 成功、base 失败的样本上，可以识别出一组较小的 generalization-controlling features。第四，特征干预给出因果证据：在 RL 模型中关闭这些特征会显著降低性能；在 base 模型中增强这些特征，可以带来未见任务上的性能提升。实验强点是从相关性走到了干预验证；需要进一步核查的是 crosscoder 重构误差、特征稳定性、不同层和不同任务上的可复现性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看实验设置，确认 base、SFT、RL 是否严格共享数据、训练步数和评测分布，这是解释结论能否成立的前提。然后读 Sparse Crosscoder 和三模型扩展，重点看它如何定义共享稀疏特征、重构损失、稀疏约束，以及 Model Attribution Score 的计算方式。第三步看训练动态图：SFT 特征数量、专属性、稳定时间；RL 特征增量、演化轨迹、与 base 表示的距离。最后看 intervention 实验，这是最值得深挖的部分。重点问题包括：被干预的特征是否真是推理通用特征，还是某类题型的隐式 detector；放大特征是否带来副作用；同一套特征能否迁移到不同模型规模、不同 reward、不同 RL 算法。建议阅读时间 1–1.5 小时，方法和干预部分需要反复看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why RL post-training often transfers beyond its training domain while SFT, starting from the same base model and using the same data, tends to introduce task-specific behavior and capability forgetting. The focus is not only on external benchmark scores. The authors align internal activations from the base, SFT-tuned, and RL-tuned models into a shared sparse feature space and analyze how each training paradigm changes representations.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a mechanistic analysis framework for post-training dynamics. Its value for pretraining research is indirect but substantial: it gives a feature-level explanation for why outcome-based RL may strengthen a compact set of transferable features, whereas SFT writes many narrow features quickly. This matters for RL pretraining, reasoning mid-training, annealing followed by RL, and using post-training behavior to diagnose pretraining data and objectives. It should be read as an interpretability and diagnostic framework, not as a new optimizer or a direct capability-improvement recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is designed for controlled comparison. The base, SFT, and RL models share the same starting checkpoint and training data, so differences can be attributed more cleanly to the training objective. The authors use Sparse Crosscoders to align residual-stream activations across models. A Sparse Crosscoder can be viewed as a cross-model sparse autoencoder: it encodes activations from different models into a shared sparse feature representation and decodes them back into each model’s activation space. This enables feature-level comparison of what is preserved, amplified, suppressed, or newly introduced. The paper then extends this to a three-model Sparse Crosscoder, jointly aligning base, SFT, and RL models rather than relying on pairwise comparisons. A Model Attribution Score measures whether a feature is more associated with one model or training paradigm. For generalization, the authors isolate cases where the RL model succeeds and the base model fails, identify features with large activation differences, and test causality by suppressing these features in the RL model or amplifying them in the base model.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not expose exact model sizes, token counts, task lists, accuracy tables, or intervention magnitudes, so exact numbers should not be inferred. The reported findings are clear. SFT rapidly introduces many highly specialized features that stabilize early in training. RL produces more restrained feature changes that continue to evolve, while preserving more of the base model’s representational structure. On samples where RL succeeds and the base model fails, the method identifies a compact set of generalization-controlling features. Interventions provide causal evidence: disabling these features in the RL-tuned model degrades performance, while amplifying them in the base model improves performance even on unseen tasks. The strongest part is the move from feature correlation to feature intervention. Key details to inspect are crosscoder reconstruction quality, feature stability, layer selection, and replication across tasks or model scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the controlled training setup and verify whether the base, SFT, and RL runs use the same data, comparable training budgets, and well-defined evaluation splits. Then read the Sparse Crosscoder and three-model extension, focusing on the shared sparse feature definition, reconstruction objective, sparsity constraint, and the Model Attribution Score. Next inspect the training-dynamics plots: number of SFT-specific features, when they stabilize, how RL features evolve, and how far each tuned model moves from the base representation. The intervention experiments deserve the most attention. Important questions are whether the identified features are truly task-agnostic reasoning features or detectors for a narrower problem family, whether amplification has side effects, and whether the same features transfer across model sizes, reward designs, or RL algorithms. Expect 1–1.5 hours for a serious read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你看 post-train 的粒度：别只盯 reward 和 benchmark，先复现它的同底模同数据对照，看 RL 是否真的比 SFT 更少写坏 base features。
recommendation.en: This shifts the lens from rewards and benchmarks to representation surgery: reproduce the same-base same-data comparison and check whether RL really damages base features less than SFT in your stack.
